sentences.zh: 時禁外國互市兵器，娎奏：「小邦北連野人，南鄰倭島，五兵之用，不可缺一。

translations.literal: At that time foreign states were forbidden from trading in weapons; Hyeon memorialized: Our small state borders wild Jurchen to the north and Wa islands to the south; the use of the five weapons cannot lack any one.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign states were then forbidden from trading in weapons. Hyeon memorialized: "Our small state borders wild Jurchen to the north and the Wa islands to the south. We cannot do without any of the five weapons of war.

sentences.zh: 而弓材所需牛角，仰于上國。

translations.literal: Yet the ox horns needed for bow wood depend on the superior state.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the ox horns needed for bow-making depend entirely on the superior state.

sentences.zh: 高皇帝時嘗賜火藥、火砲，今望特許收買弓角，不與外番同禁。

translations.literal: In the time of the August Emperor gunpowder and cannon were once granted; now we hope for special permission to purchase bow horns, not sharing the prohibition with other foreign tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of the August Emperor gunpowder and cannon were once granted to us. We now hope for special permission to purchase bow horns, and not to be subject to the same prohibition as other foreign peoples."

sentences.zh: 」兵部議歲市弓角五十，後以不足於用，請無限額，詔許倍市。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated an annual market of fifty bow horns; later because this was insufficient for use, they requested no limit; an edict permitted double the quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War fixed an annual purchase of fifty bow horns. When this proved insufficient, an unlimited quota was requested, and an edict permitted purchasing at double the original amount.

sentences.zh: 十五年十月命娎出兵夾擊建州女直。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifteenth year Hyeon was ordered to dispatch troops in pincer attack on Jianzhou Jurchen.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifteenth year Hyeon was ordered to dispatch troops for a pincer attack against the Jianzhou Jurchen.

sentences.zh: 娎遂遣右贊成魚有沼率兵至滿浦江，以水泮後期。

translations.literal: Hyeon then sent Right Chancery Councillor Yu Yozhao leading troops to the Manpu River but was late because the ice had melted.
translations.idiomatic: Hyeon then sent Yu Yozhao, Right Chancery Councillor, with troops to the Manpu River, but they arrived late because the ice had melted.

sentences.zh: 復遣左議政尹弼商、節度使金嶠等渡江進剿。

translations.literal: Again Left State Councillor Yin Bishang, military commissioner Jin Qiao and others crossed the river to advance in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent Left State Councillor Yin Bishang, Military Commissioner Jin Qiao, and others across the river to advance in suppression.

sentences.zh: 十六年春遣陪臣來獻捷，帝命內官齎敕獎其能繼先烈，賜金幣，領兵官賞賚如例。

translations.literal: In spring of the sixteenth year envoys were sent to report victory; the emperor ordered palace officials to carry an instruction commending their ability to follow forefathers' achievement; gold and silks were granted; leading officers received rewards as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixteenth year envoys were sent to report victory. The emperor ordered palace officials to convey an instruction commending their ability to carry on their forefathers' achievements, granted gold and silks, and rewarded the commanding officers according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 後使還，遣其臣許熙伴送。

translations.literal: Later when the envoy returned, his minister Xu Xi was sent to escort them.
translations.idiomatic: When the envoys later returned, Hyeon dispatched his minister Xu Xi to escort the imperial messenger.

sentences.zh: 熙歸至開州，建州騎二千邀之，掠其從卒三十余人，馬二百三十餘匹，他所亡物稱是。

translations.literal: Xi returned as far as Kaichou when two thousand Jianzhou horsemen intercepted him, plundering more than thirty followers, more than two hundred thirty horses, and comparable losses of other goods.
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Xi reached Kaichou on his return, two thousand Jianzhou horsemen waylaid him, plundering more than thirty of his attendants, over two hundred thirty horses, and a comparable quantity of other goods.

sentences.zh: 奏聞，英國公張懋、吏部尚書尹旻等以遼東連年用兵，未可輕動，宜以此意諭娎。

translations.literal: On memorial the Duke of Ying Zhang Mao, Minister of Personnel Yin Min and others, because Liaodong had seen military use year after year and could not be lightly stirred, held that this intent should be conveyed to Hyeon.
translations.idiomatic: On receiving the report, the Duke of Ying Zhang Mao, Minister of Personnel Yin Min, and others held that because Liaodong had seen warfare year after year and could not be lightly disturbed, this sentiment should be conveyed to Hyeon.

sentences.zh: 敕遼東守臣整飭邊備，更令譯者窮究所掠，期在必得，仍賜熙白金彩幣慰安之。

translations.literal: An instruction ordered Liaodong garrison officials to ready border defenses; interpreters were further ordered to investigate thoroughly what was plundered, with expectation of certain recovery; Xu Xi was still granted white gold and colored silks to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: An instruction ordered Liaodong officials to strengthen border defenses, and further ordered interpreters to pursue a thorough investigation of the plunder with every expectation of recovery. Xu Xi was also granted white gold and colored silks by way of consolation.

sentences.zh: 十七年，娎奏繼妃尹氏失德，廢置，乞更封副室尹氏。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Hyeon memorialized that his second consort Lady Yun was devoid of virtue and had been deposed; he begged to invest instead the secondary consort Lady Yun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Hyeon memorialized that his second consort Lady Yun had proved devoid of virtue and been deposed, and requested that his secondary consort Lady Yun be invested in her stead.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: This was granted.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月封娎長子㦕為世子。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year Hyeon's eldest son Yeon was invested as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year Hyeon's eldest son Yeon was invested as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 弘治七年十二月，娎卒，賜諡康靖。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year of Hongzhi Hyeon died; the posthumous title Kangjing was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the seventh year of Hongzhi Hyeon died and was granted the posthumous title Kangjing.

sentences.zh: 明年四月，封㦕為國，妻慎氏為王妃。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the following year Yeon was invested as king; his wife Lady Shen was invested as queen consort.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the following year Yeon was invested as king, and his wife Lady Shen was invested as queen consort.

sentences.zh: 十二年，㦕奏：「本國人屢有違禁匿海島，誘引軍民，漸至滋蔓。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Yeon memorialized: Our people have repeatedly violated prohibitions by hiding on sea islands, luring soldiers and civilians, gradually spreading.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Yeon memorialized: "Our people have repeatedly violated the prohibitions by hiding on sea islands and luring away soldiers and civilians, and the problem has gradually spread.

sentences.zh: 乞許本國自行搜刷。

translations.literal: We beg permission for our state to conduct searches and purges on its own.
translations.idiomatic: We beg permission for our state to conduct searches and purges on its own.

sentences.zh: 其系上國地方，請敕官追捕。

translations.literal: As for those in territory of the superior state, we request an instruction for officials to pursue and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: As for those found in territory of the superior state, we request that officials be instructed to pursue and capture them."

sentences.zh: 」時遼東守臣亦奏如㦕言，報可。

translations.literal: At that time Liaodong garrison officials also memorialized as Yeon said; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Liaodong garrison officials also memorialized to the same effect as Yeon, and this was approved.

sentences.zh: 十五年冬，封㦕長子為世子。

translations.literal: In winter of the fifteenth year Yeon's eldest son was invested as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifteenth year Yeon's eldest son was invested as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 正德二年，㦕以世子夭亡，哀慟成疾，奏請以國事付其弟懌，其國人復奏請封懌。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengde, because the heir apparent died young Yeon grieved into illness and memorialized requesting that state affairs be entrusted to his younger brother Eul; his people again memorialized requesting Eul be invested.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengde, when the heir apparent died young, Yeon grieved himself into illness and memorialized requesting that state affairs be entrusted to his younger brother Eul; his subjects also memorialized requesting that Eul be invested.

sentences.zh: 禮部議命懌權理國事，俟㦕卒乃封。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites deliberated ordering Eul to manage state affairs provisionally, investing him only after Yeon died.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites deliberated that Eul should be ordered to manage state affairs provisionally, with formal investiture to follow only after Yeon's death.

sentences.zh: 既，陪臣盧公弼等以朝貢至京，復請封懌，廷議不允。

translations.literal: Thereafter envoys Lu Gongbi and others came to the capital on tribute and again requested Eul be invested; court deliberation did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the envoys Lu Gongbi and others arrived at the capital on tribute, they again requested that Eul be invested, but court deliberation did not consent.

sentences.zh: 十二月，㦕母妃奏懌長且賢，堪付重寄。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Yeon's queen mother memorialized that Eul was elder and worthy, fit to be entrusted with weighty responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Yeon's queen mother memorialized that Eul was older and worthy, and fit to be entrusted with grave responsibility.

sentences.zh: 於是禮部奏：「㦕以痼疾辭位，懌以親弟承托，接受既明，友愛不失。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Ministry of Rites memorialized: Yeon, owing to chronic illness, abdicated; Eul, as younger brother, received the trust; the transfer was clear and brotherly affection was not lost.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Ministry of Rites memorialized: "Yeon, owing to chronic illness, has abdicated; Eul, as his younger brother, has accepted the trust. The transfer of authority is clear and brotherly affection remains intact.

sentences.zh: 通國臣民舉無異詞，宜順其請。

translations.literal: Throughout the state officials and people unanimously raise no objection; their request should be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the kingdom officials and people are unanimously agreed; their request should be granted."

sentences.zh: 」上乃允懌嗣位，遣中官敕封，並賜其妃尹氏誥命。

translations.literal: The emperor then permitted Eul to succeed; palace eunuchs were dispatched with an instruction to invest him, and patent of appointment was also granted to his consort Lady Yun.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then permitted Eul to succeed. Palace eunuchs were dispatched with an instruction to invest him, and patent of appointment was also granted to his consort Lady Yun.

sentences.zh: 初，成桂之自立也，與宰相李仁人本異族。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Seong Gye established himself, he and Chancellor Li Renren were originally of different clans.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Seong Gye established himself in power, he and Chancellor Li Renren had originally been of different clans.

sentences.zh: 永樂間，降祭海岳祝文，稱成桂為仁人子，而《祖訓》亦載仁人子成桂更名旦。

translations.literal: In the Yongle reign, when sacrificial texts to mountains and seas were issued, Seong Gye was called Renren's son, and the Ancestral Admonitions also records Renren's son Seong Gye renamed Dan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongle reign, when sacrificial texts to the mountains and seas were issued, Seong Gye was called the son of Renren, and the Ancestral Admonitions also records "Renren's son Seong Gye, renamed Dan."

sentences.zh: 後成桂子芳遠奏辨，太宗許令改正。

translations.literal: Later Seong Gye's son Bang-won memorialized in defense; the Taizong Emperor permitted correction.
translations.idiomatic: Later Seong Gye's son Bang-won memorialized in defense, and the Taizong Emperor permitted the record to be corrected.

sentences.zh: 至是修《大明會典》，仍列《祖訓》于朝鮮國。

translations.literal: At this time in revising the Collected Statutes of the Great Ming, the Ancestral Admonitions was still listed under the Korean state.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, while revising the Collected Statutes of the Great Ming, the Ancestral Admonitions was still listed under the Korean state.

sentences.zh: 貢使市以歸，懌上疏備陳世系，辨先世無弑逆事，乞改正。

translations.literal: The tribute envoy purchased a copy and returned; Eul submitted a memorial fully setting forth the dynastic line, arguing that forebears had never committed regicide, and begging correction.
translations.idiomatic: A tribute envoy purchased a copy and returned with it. Eul submitted a memorial fully setting forth his dynastic line, arguing that his forebears had never committed regicide, and begged that the record be corrected.

sentences.zh: 禮部議：「《會典》詳載本朝制度，事涉外國，疑似之際，在所略。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites deliberated: The Collected Statutes fully records this dynasty's institutions; matters involving foreign states, at points of doubt, are to be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites deliberated: "The Collected Statutes fully records this dynasty's institutions; where matters involve foreign states and points remain doubtful, they are to be omitted.

sentences.zh: 況成桂得國出皇祖命，其不系仁人後，太宗詔可征，宜從其請。

translations.literal: Moreover Seong Gye's obtaining the state issued from the imperial ancestor's command; that he was not of Renren's line—the Taizong Emperor's edict may serve as proof; their request should be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Seong Gye's obtaining the throne issued from the imperial ancestor's command, and that he was not of Renren's line was confirmed by the Taizong Emperor's edict. Their request should be granted."

translations.literal: An edict said: Permitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Permitted."

sentences.zh: 十五年冬，命內官封懌子峼為世子，賜懌金帛珠玉，令括取異物及童男女以進。

translations.literal: In winter of the fifteenth year palace eunuchs were ordered to invest Eul's son Jeong as heir apparent; Eul was granted gold, silks, pearls, and jade, and ordered to gather exotic goods and boys and girls to present.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifteenth year palace eunuchs were ordered to invest Eul's son Jeong as heir apparent. Eul was granted gold, silks, pearls, and jade, and ordered to gather exotic goods and boys and girls to present as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十六年，世宗即位，禮官言：「天子初踐祚，宜正中國之體，絕外裔狎侮之端。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Shizong ascended the throne; ritual officials said: When the Son of Heaven first treads the throne, the dignity of the Central State should be set right and the beginnings of foreign presumption cut off.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the Shizong Emperor ascended the throne. The ritual officials said: "When the Son of Heaven first ascends the throne, the dignity of the Central State should be set right and the beginnings of foreign presumption cut off.

sentences.zh: 請諭懌非朝廷意，召內臣還，毋有所索取。

translations.literal: We request that Eul be instructed this was not the court's intent, the palace eunuchs be recalled, and nothing be demanded.
translations.idiomatic: We request that Eul be told this was not the court's intent, that the palace eunuchs be recalled, and that nothing further be demanded."

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年八月，以俘獲倭夷來獻，並送還中國被掠八人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Jiajing, captives of Wa barbarians were presented, and eight Chinese who had been seized were also returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Jiajing, captives of Wa barbarians were presented, and eight Chinese subjects who had been seized were also returned.

sentences.zh: 賜白金錦糸寧。

translations.literal: White gold and brocade silks were granted.
translations.idiomatic: White gold and brocade silks were granted in reward.

sentences.zh: 八年八月，陪臣柳溥上言：國祖李旦系本國全州人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year the envoy Liu Pu stated: Our dynastic founder Li Dan was a native of Jeonju in our state.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the eighth year the envoy Liu Pu stated: "Our dynastic founder Li Dan was a native of Jeonju in our state.

sentences.zh: 二十八世祖瀚仕新羅為司空。

translations.literal: The twenty-eighth-generation ancestor Han served Silla as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Our twenty-eighth-generation ancestor Han served Silla as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 新羅亡，六世孫兢休入高麗。

translations.literal: When Silla perished, the sixth-generation descendant Gyeong-hyu entered Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: When Silla perished, the sixth-generation descendant Gyeong-hyu entered Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 十三世孫安社仕元為南京千戶所達魯花赤。

translations.literal: The thirteenth-generation descendant An-sa served Yuan as darughachi of the Nanjing Thousand-Household Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth-generation descendant An-sa served the Yuan as darughachi of the Nanjing Thousand-Household Guard.

sentences.zh: 元季兵興，安曾孫子春與男成桂避地東遷。

translations.literal: When warfare arose in the late Yuan, An-sa's great-great-grandson Ja-chun and his son Seong Gye moved east to avoid the turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: When warfare arose in the late Yuan, An-sa's great-great-grandson Ja-chun and his son Seong Gye moved east to escape the turmoil.

sentences.zh: 至正辛丑，當恭湣王之十年，有紅巾賊入境，成桂擊賊有功，授武班職事，時尚未知名。

translations.literal: In xinchou of the Zhizheng era, the tenth year of King Gongmin, Red Turban bandits entered the territory; Seong Gye struck the bandits with merit and was appointed to a military office, though he was not yet known by name.
translations.idiomatic: In xinchou of the Zhizheng era, the tenth year of King Gongmin, Red Turban bandits entered the territory. Seong Gye struck the bandits with merit and was appointed to a military office, though he was not yet widely known.

sentences.zh: 恭湣無嗣，陰蓄寵臣辛肫之子禑為子，晚為嬖臣洪倫、內豎崔萬生所弑。

translations.literal: Gongmin had no heir; he secretly kept the favored minister Sin Don's son Ui as his son; in his later years he was assassinated by the favorite Hong Lun and the palace attendant Cui Man-saeng.
translations.idiomatic: Gongmin had no heir. He secretly adopted Sin Don's son Ui as his own, and in his later years was assassinated by the favorite Hong Lun and the palace attendant Cui Man-saeng.

sentences.zh: 權臣李仁人誅倫、萬生而立禑，擢成桂為門下侍中。

translations.literal: Powerful minister Li Renren executed Lun and Man-saeng and established Ui, promoting Seong Gye to Palace Attendant-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: The powerful minister Li Renren executed Lun and Man-saeng and established Ui on the throne, promoting Seong Gye to Palace Attendant-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 禑遣成桂侵遼東，成桂不從，返兵。

translations.literal: Ui sent Seong Gye to invade Liaodong; Seong Gye did not obey and turned the army back.
translations.idiomatic: Ui sent Seong Gye to invade Liaodong, but Seong Gye refused and turned the army back.

sentences.zh: 禑懼，遜位於子昌。

translations.literal: Ui feared and abdicated to his son Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Ui, in fear, abdicated in favor of his son Chang.

sentences.zh: 昌以偽姓見黜，復立王氏裔定昌君瑤，竄仁人於外。

translations.literal: Chang was dismissed for using a false surname; the Wang-clan descendant Prince Jeongchang Yao was restored, and Renren was banished abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Chang was dismissed for using a false surname. The Wang-clan descendant Prince Jeongchang Yao was restored to the throne, and Renren was banished abroad.

sentences.zh: 瑤復不道，國人戴成桂，請于高皇帝，立為王，更名旦，贍瑤別邸，終其身，實未嘗為弑。

translations.literal: Yao again was unprincipled; the people upheld Seong Gye, requested the August Emperor, and established him as king, renaming him Dan; Yao was housed in a separate residence for life—he was in fact never murdered.
translations.idiomatic: Yao again proved unprincipled. The people upheld Seong Gye, petitioned the August Emperor, and established him as king, renaming him Dan. Yao was housed in a separate residence for life—he was in fact never murdered.

sentences.zh: 前永樂、正德間屢經奏請，俱蒙俞允，而迄未改正。

translations.literal: Previously in the Yongle and Zhengde reigns memorials had repeatedly been submitted and all had received approval, yet correction had never been carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, during the Yongle and Zhengde reigns, memorials had repeatedly been submitted and all had received approval, yet the record had never been corrected.

sentences.zh: 今遇重修《會典》，乞賜昭雪。

translations.literal: Now encountering revision of the Collected Statutes, we beg exoneration be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Now, as the Collected Statutes are being revised, we beg that exoneration be granted."

sentences.zh: 」詔送史館編纂。

translations.literal: An edict ordered it sent to the Historiography Institute for compilation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the matter sent to the Historiography Institute for compilation.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，睿宗祔太廟，配享明堂禮成，懌表賀。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighteenth year, when the rites were completed for enshrining Ruizong in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and associating him in worship at the Bright Hall, Eul submitted a congratulatory memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighteenth year, when the rites were completed for enshrining the Ruizong Emperor in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and associating him in worship at the Bright Hall, Eul submitted a congratulatory memorial.

sentences.zh: 帝特禦奉天門引見，賜宴禮部。

translations.literal: The emperor specially proceeded to the Gate of Receiving Heaven to grant audience and bestowed a banquet at the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor specially proceeded to the Gate of Receiving Heaven to grant him audience and bestowed a banquet at the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二十三年冬，懌卒。

translations.literal: In winter of the twenty-third year Eul died.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the twenty-third year Eul died.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月來訃，賜諡恭僖。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year mourning was reported; the posthumous title Gongxi was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year mourning was reported, and the posthumous title Gongxi was granted.

sentences.zh: 詔立其子峼。

translations.literal: An edict established his son Jeong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established his son Jeong as king.

sentences.zh: 峼未逾年卒，賜諡榮靖。

translations.literal: Jeong died within the year; the posthumous title Rongjing was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Jeong died within the year and was granted the posthumous title Rongjing.

sentences.zh: 九月，峼弟權國事峘遣使謝祭諡，並請襲封，詔許之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Jeong's younger brother Sun, managing state affairs, dispatched envoys to thank for the sacrificial offerings and posthumous title and to request investiture by succession; an edict permitted this.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Jeong's younger brother Sun, who was managing state affairs, dispatched envoys to thank the court for the sacrificial offerings and posthumous title and to request succession by investiture; an edict permitted this.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，峘遣使送下海番人六百余至邊，賜金幣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Sun dispatched envoys to send more than six hundred overseas barbarians to the border; gold and silks were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Sun dispatched envoys to send more than six hundred overseas barbarians to the border, and gold and silks were granted in reward.

sentences.zh: 二十六年正月，峘咨稱：「福建人從無泛海至本國者，因往日本市易，為風所漂，前後共獲千人以上，皆挾軍器貨物，致中國火砲亦為倭有，恐起兵端。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-sixth year Sun reported: Never before had people from Fujian sailed the seas to our state; going to trade in Japan, they were blown off course by wind; more than a thousand were captured before and after, all carrying weapons and goods, so that Chinese cannon also fell into Wa hands—fearing this would spark war.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-sixth year Sun reported: "Never before had people from Fujian sailed the seas to our state. Having gone to trade in Japan, they were blown off course by wind; more than a thousand were captured in all, all carrying weapons and goods, so that Chinese cannon also fell into Wa hands—we fear this may spark war.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「頃年沿海奸民犯禁，福建尤甚，往往為外國所獲，有傷國體。

translations.literal: An edict: In recent years coastal wicked people violated prohibitions, Fujian especially; often they were seized by foreign states, harming national dignity.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "In recent years wicked people along the coast have violated the prohibitions, Fujian especially. They have often been seized by foreign states, to the harm of national dignity.

sentences.zh: 海道官員令巡按御史察參。

translations.literal: Maritime-route officials were ordered to be inspected and impeached by touring censors.
translations.idiomatic: Officials responsible for maritime routes were ordered to be investigated and impeached by touring censors.

sentences.zh: 仍賜王銀幣，以旌其忠。」

translations.literal: Silver and silks were still granted to the king to honor his loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: Silver and silks were still granted to the king in recognition of his loyalty."

sentences.zh: 三十一年冬，以洪武、永樂間所賜樂器敝壞，奏求律管，更乞遣樂官赴京校習，許之。

translations.literal: In winter of the thirty-first year, because musical instruments granted in the Hongwu and Yongle periods were worn and broken, a memorial requested pitch-pipes; further requesting that musicians be dispatched to the capital for training—approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirty-first year, because the musical instruments granted during the Hongwu and Yongle reigns had fallen into disrepair, a memorial requested new pitch-pipes and asked that musicians be sent to the capital for training; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三十五年五月有倭船四自浙、直敗還，漂入朝鮮境。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirty-fifth year four Wa ships, defeated while returning from Zhejiang and Zhili, drifted into Korean territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the thirty-fifth year four Japanese ships, beaten while returning from Zhejiang and Zhili, were driven by wind and tide into Korean waters.

sentences.zh: 峘遣兵擊殲之，得中國被俘及助逆者三十餘人來獻，因賀冬至節，帝賜璽書褒諭。

translations.literal: Sun dispatched troops to attack and destroy them, obtained more than thirty captured Chinese and rebels who assisted them and sent them as tribute; because of congratulating on the Winter Solstice festival, the emperor granted a sealed letter of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Sun dispatched troops to attack and annihilate them, recovered more than thirty captured Chinese and renegades who had aided the enemy, and sent them to the court as tribute. On the occasion of his congratulations for the Winter Solstice, the emperor rewarded him with an imperial sealed letter of praise.

sentences.zh: 三十八年十一月奏：「今年五月，有倭寇駕船二十五隻來抵海岸，臣命將李鐸等剿殺殆盡，獲中國民陳春等三百餘人，內招通倭嚮導陳得等十六人，俱獻闕下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the thirty-eighth year a memorial stated: "This year in the fifth month, twenty-five Wa pirate ships came to the coast; your subject ordered Generals Li T'o and others to exterminate nearly all of them, capturing more than three hundred Chinese civilians including Chen Chun; among them sixteen who had colluded with the Wa as guides, including Chen De, were all sent to the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the thirty-eighth year a memorial stated: "This year in the fifth month twenty-five Wa pirate ships reached the coast. Your subject ordered Generals Li T'o and others to exterminate nearly all of them, recovering more than three hundred Chinese civilians including Chen Chun. Among them were sixteen who had colluded with the Wa as guides, including Chen De—all were sent to the court.

sentences.zh: 」復降敕獎勵，厚賚銀幣，並賜鐸等有差。

translations.literal: " An edict was again issued commending and rewarding them, generously granting silver and silks, and T'o and the others were rewarded according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict was again issued commending and rewarding them, generously granting silver and silks, and T'o and the others were rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 四十二年九月，峘復上書辨先世非李仁人後，今修《會典》雖蒙厘正，乞著始祖旦、父子春之名，帝令附錄《會典》。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the forty-second year Sun again submitted a memorial clarifying that his forebears were not descendants of Li Renren; although the revised Collected Statutes had been corrected, he begged that the names of the founding ancestor Dan and his son Zichun be recorded; the emperor ordered them appended to the Collected Statutes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the forty-second year Sun again submitted a memorial clarifying that his forebears were not descendants of Li Renren. Although the revised Collected Statutes of the Ming Dynasty had been corrected on this point, he begged that the names of the founding ancestor Dan and his son Zichun be formally recorded; the emperor ordered them appended to the Collected Statutes.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年六月遣官頒即位詔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Longqing officials were dispatched to proclaim the accession edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Longqing officials were dispatched to proclaim the accession edict.

sentences.zh: 時帝將幸太學，來使乞留觀禮，許之。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor was about to visit the Imperial Academy; the envoy requested to remain and observe the rites; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor was about to visit the Imperial Academy; the envoy requested permission to remain and observe the ceremony, and this was granted.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，峘卒，賜諡恭憲，命其侄昖襲封。

translations.literal: That winter Sun died; the posthumous title Gongxian was granted, and his nephew Seon was ordered to succeed to the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Sun died and was granted the posthumous title Gongxian; his nephew Seon was ordered to succeed to the kingship.

sentences.zh: 萬曆元年正月上穆宗尊諡、兩宮徽號禮成，昖表賀，獻方物馬匹。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Wanli, when the rites were completed for bestowing the posthumous title upon the Muzong Emperor and the honorific titles upon the two palaces, Seon submitted a congratulatory memorial and presented local products and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Wanli, when the rites were completed for bestowing the posthumous title upon the Muzong Emperor and the honorific titles upon the two palaces, Seon submitted a congratulatory memorial and presented local products and horses.

sentences.zh: 時昖屢請賜《皇明會典》，為其先康獻王旦雪冤。

translations.literal: At that time Seon repeatedly requested a copy of the Collected Statutes of the Ming Dynasty to clear the name of his forebear King Kangxian Dan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Seon repeatedly requested a copy of the Collected Statutes of the Ming Dynasty to vindicate his forebear King Kangxian Dan.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，《會典》成，適貢使愈泓在京，請給前書，以終前命。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year the Collected Statutes were completed; the tribute envoy Yu Hong happened to be in the capital and requested the book previously promised, to fulfill the earlier command.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixteenth year the Collected Statutes were completed; the tribute envoy Yu Hong happened to be in the capital and requested the book previously promised, to fulfill the earlier command.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 十七年十一月，陪臣奇芩等入賀冬至，奏稱本年六月，大琉球國船遭風至海岸，所有男婦合解京，給文放歸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventeenth year the attendant minister Gi Eun and others came to congratulate on the Winter Solstice and memorialized that in the sixth month of that year a ship of Great Ryukyu had been blown by wind to the coast; all the men and women aboard should be sent together to the capital and then released with travel documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the seventeenth year the attendant minister Gi Eun and others came to congratulate on the Winter Solstice and reported that in the sixth month of that year a ship from Great Ryukyu had been blown by wind to the coast; all the men and women aboard should be sent together to the capital and then released with travel documents.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 十九年十一月奏，倭酋關白平秀吉聲言明年三月來犯，詔兵部申飭海防。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the nineteenth year a memorial stated that the Wa chieftain the regent Hideyoshi declared he would invade in the third month of the following year; an edict ordered the Ministry of War to tighten coastal defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the nineteenth year a memorial reported that the Wa chieftain the regent Hideyoshi declared he would invade in the third month of the following year; an edict ordered the Ministry of War to tighten coastal defenses.

sentences.zh: 平秀吉者，薩摩州人，初隨倭關白信長。

translations.literal: Hideyoshi was a man of Satsuma province; initially he followed the Wa regent Nobunaga.
translations.idiomatic: Hideyoshi was a man of Satsuma province who initially served the Wa regent Nobunaga.

sentences.zh: 會信長為其下所弑，秀吉遂統信長兵，自號關白，劫降六十餘州。

translations.literal: When Nobunaga was assassinated by his subordinates, Hideyoshi thereupon took command of Nobunaga's armies, styled himself regent, and by force and surrender subjugated more than sixty provinces.
translations.idiomatic: When Nobunaga was assassinated by his subordinates, Hideyoshi took command of Nobunaga's armies, styled himself regent, and by force and surrender subjugated more than sixty provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮與日本對馬島相望，時有倭夷往來互市。

translations.literal: Korea and Japan's Tsushima Island face each other across the sea; at times Wa barbarians came and went to trade.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Japan's Tsushima Island face each other across the sea, and Wa traders came and went between them.

sentences.zh: 二十年夏五月，秀吉遂分渠帥行長、清正等率舟師逼釜山鎮，潛渡臨津。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer in the twentieth year Hideyoshi then divided his commanders Yukinaga, Kiyomasa, and others to lead a fleet against Busan garrison, secretly crossing the Imjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer in the twentieth year Hideyoshi sent his commanders Yukinaga, Kiyomasa, and others at the head of a fleet against Busan garrison and secretly crossed the Imjin.

sentences.zh: 時朝鮮承平久，兵不習戰，昖又湎酒，弛備，猝島夷作難，望風皆潰。

translations.literal: At that time Korea had long enjoyed peace; troops were unaccustomed to war; Seon moreover drowned himself in wine and relaxed defenses; suddenly the island barbarians rose in revolt and all fled at the mere sight of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Korea had long enjoyed peace, its troops were unaccustomed to war, and Seon drowned himself in wine and neglected defenses; when the island barbarians suddenly rose in revolt, the armies fled at the mere sight of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 昖棄王城，令次子琿攝國事，奔平壤。

translations.literal: Seon abandoned the royal capital, ordered his second son Hui to administer state affairs, and fled to Pyongyang.
translations.idiomatic: Seon abandoned the royal capital, ordered his second son Hui to administer state affairs, and fled to Pyongyang.

sentences.zh: 已，復走義州，願內屬。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he fled again to Uiju and requested to become an inner subject of the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he fled again to Uiju and requested to submit to Ming protection.

sentences.zh: 七月，兵部議令駐劄險要，以待天兵；

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Ministry of War deliberated ordering him to hold fast at strategic points and await the Celestial army;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Ministry of War deliberated ordering him to hold fast at strategic points and await the Celestial army;

sentences.zh: 號召通國勤王，以圖恢復。

translations.literal: to summon the whole country to defend the throne and plan recovery.
translations.idiomatic: to summon the whole country to defend the throne and plan the recovery of the realm.

sentences.zh: 而是時倭已入王京，毀墳墓，劫王子、陪臣，剽府庫，八道幾盡沒，旦暮且渡鴨綠江，請援之使絡繹於道。

translations.literal: But by then the Wa had already entered the royal capital, destroyed tombs, seized princes and attendant ministers, and plundered treasuries; nearly all eight provinces were lost; morning and evening they would cross the Yalu River; envoys begging aid thronged the roads.
translations.idiomatic: But by then the Wa had already entered the royal capital, destroyed tombs, seized princes and attendant ministers, and plundered treasuries; nearly all eight provinces were lost and they were on the verge of crossing the Yalu River at any moment; envoys begging for aid thronged the roads.

sentences.zh: 廷議以朝鮮為國籓籬，在所必爭。

translations.literal: Court deliberation held that Korea was the outer screen of the realm and must be contested at all costs.
translations.idiomatic: Court deliberation held that Korea was the outer bulwark of the realm and must be defended at all costs.

sentences.zh: 遣行人薛潘諭昖以興復大義，揚言大兵十萬且至。

translations.literal: The emissary Xue Pan was dispatched to instruct Seon in the great principle of restoration and to proclaim that a hundred thousand troops would soon arrive.
translations.idiomatic: The emissary Xue Pan was dispatched to instruct Seon in the great principle of restoration and to proclaim that a hundred thousand Ming troops would soon arrive.

sentences.zh: 而倭業抵平壤，朝鮮君臣益急，出避愛州。

translations.literal: But the Wa had already reached Pyongyang; the Korean king and ministers grew still more desperate and withdrew to Aiju.
translations.idiomatic: But the Wa had already reached Pyongyang; the Korean king and ministers grew still more desperate and withdrew to Aiju.

sentences.zh: 遊擊史儒等率師至平壤，戰死。

translations.literal: Guerrilla commander Shi Ru and others led troops to Pyongyang and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Guerrilla commander Shi Ru and others led troops to Pyongyang and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 副總兵祖承訓統兵渡鴨綠江援之，僅以身免。

translations.literal: Vice commander-in-chief Zu Chengxun led troops across the Yalu River to aid them and barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Vice commander-in-chief Zu Chengxun led troops across the Yalu River to aid them and barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 中朝震動，以宋應昌為經略。

translations.literal: The Central Court was shaken, and Song Yingchang was appointed strategic coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Court was shaken, and Song Yingchang was appointed strategic coordinator.

sentences.zh: 八月，倭入豐德等郡，兵部尚書石星計無所出，議遣人偵探之，於是嘉興人沈惟敬應募。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Wa entered Pungdok and other prefectures; Minister of War Shi Xing could devise no plan and deliberated sending someone to reconnoiter; thereupon Shen Weijing of Jiaxing answered the call.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Wa entered Pungdok and other prefectures; Minister of War Shi Xing could devise no plan and proposed sending someone to reconnoiter, and Shen Weijing of Jiaxing answered the call.

sentences.zh: 惟敬者，市中無賴也。

translations.literal: Weijing was a rogue of the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Weijing was a marketplace ruffian.

sentences.zh: 是時秀吉次對馬島，分其將行長等守要害為聲援。

translations.literal: At that time Hideyoshi was stationed at Tsushima Island and divided his generals Yukinaga and others to hold strategic points as a supporting force.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hideyoshi was stationed at Tsushima Island and posted his generals Yukinaga and others at strategic points as a supporting force.

sentences.zh: 惟敬至平壤，執禮其卑。

translations.literal: Weijing reached Pyongyang and observed the most abject ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Weijing reached Pyongyang and abased himself in the most servile manner.

sentences.zh: 行長紿曰：「天朝幸按兵不動，我不久當還。

translations.literal: Yukinaga deceived him, saying: "The Celestial Court fortunately holds its troops still; I shall soon return.
translations.idiomatic: Yukinaga deceived him, saying: "The Celestial Court has fortunately held its troops in check; I shall soon withdraw.

sentences.zh: 以大同江為界，平壤以西盡屬朝鮮耳。

translations.literal: With the Taedong River as the boundary, all west of Pyongyang belongs to Korea alone.
translations.idiomatic: With the Taedong River as the boundary, everything west of Pyongyang will belong to Korea alone.

sentences.zh: 」惟敬以聞。

translations.literal: " Weijing reported this.
translations.idiomatic: " Weijing reported this to the court.

sentences.zh: 廷議倭詐未可信，乃趣應昌等進兵。

translations.literal: Court deliberation held the Wa deception could not be trusted; thereupon Song Yingchang and others were urged to advance.
translations.idiomatic: Court deliberation held that the Wa could not be trusted and urged Song Yingchang and others to advance.

sentences.zh: 而星頗惑於惟敬，乃題署遊擊，赴軍前，且請金行間。

translations.literal: But Shi Xing was quite misled by Weijing; he thereupon granted him the title of guerrilla commander and sent him to the front, and moreover requested gold for secret operations.
translations.idiomatic: But Shi Xing was quite taken in by Weijing; he granted him the title of guerrilla commander and sent him to the front, and moreover requested gold for covert operations.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以李如松為東征提督。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Li Rusong was made overall commander of the eastern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Li Rusong was appointed overall commander of the eastern expedition.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，如松督諸將進戰，大捷於平壤。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year Rusong supervised the generals in advancing to battle and won a great victory at Pyongyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year Rusong led the generals into battle and won a great victory at Pyongyang.

sentences.zh: 行長渡大同江，遁還龍山。

translations.literal: Yukinaga crossed the Taedong River and fled back to Ryongsan.
translations.idiomatic: Yukinaga crossed the Taedong River and fled back to Ryongsan.

sentences.zh: 所失黃海、平安、京畿、江原四道並復，清正亦遁還王京。

translations.literal: The four lost provinces of Hwanghae, Pyongan, Gyeonggi, and Gangwon were all recovered, and Kiyomasa also fled back to the royal capital.
translations.idiomatic: The four lost provinces of Hwanghae, Pyongan, Gyeonggi, and Gangwon were all recovered, and Kiyomasa also fled back to the royal capital.

sentences.zh: 如松既勝，輕騎趨碧蹄館，敗，退駐開城。

translations.literal: After Rusong's victory, with light cavalry he pressed toward Pyeokjicheon garrison, was defeated, and withdrew to garrison at Kaesong.
translations.idiomatic: After his victory Rusong pressed forward with light cavalry toward Pyeokjicheon garrison, was defeated, and withdrew to Kaesong.

sentences.zh: 事具《如松傳》。

translations.literal: The full account is given in the Biography of Rusong.
translations.idiomatic: The full account is given in the Biography of Li Rusong.

sentences.zh: 初，如松誓師，欲斬惟敬，以參軍李應試言而止。

translations.literal: Initially, when Rusong swore in the army, he wished to execute Weijing, but stopped on the advice of staff officer Li Yingshi.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset, when Rusong mustered the army, he wished to execute Weijing but desisted on the advice of staff officer Li Yingshi.

sentences.zh: 至是敗，氣縮，而應昌急圖成功，倭亦乏食有歸志，因而封貢之議起。

translations.literal: At this defeat morale shrank; Song Yingchang urgently sought success; the Wa also lacked food and wished to return; thus arose deliberation over investiture and tribute.
translations.idiomatic: After this defeat morale collapsed; Song Yingchang urgently sought a settlement; the Wa also lacked provisions and wished to withdraw; and thus arose deliberation over investiture and tribute.

sentences.zh: 應昌得倭報惟敬書，乃令遊擊周弘謨同惟敬往諭倭，獻王京，返王子，如約縱歸。

translations.literal: Song Yingchang received a Wa report and Weijing's letter; he thereupon ordered guerrilla commander Zhou Hongmo together with Weijing to go instruct the Wa to surrender the royal capital, return the princes, and release captives as agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yingchang received a Wa report and Weijing's letter and ordered guerrilla commander Zhou Hongmo together with Weijing to instruct the Wa to surrender the royal capital, return the princes, and release captives as agreed.

sentences.zh: 倭果于四月棄王城遁。

translations.literal: The Wa indeed abandoned the royal city and fled in the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: The Wa indeed abandoned the royal city and fled in the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 時漢江以南千有餘里朝鮮故土復定，兵部言宜令王還國居守，我各鎮兵久疲海外，以次撤歸為便。

translations.literal: At that time more than a thousand li of Korean territory south of the Han River was restored; the Ministry of War stated the king should be ordered to return and hold the country, while our garrison troops, long exhausted overseas, should be withdrawn in turn for convenience.
translations.idiomatic: At that time more than a thousand li of Korean territory south of the Han River had been restored; the Ministry of War argued that the king should be ordered to return and hold the country while our garrison troops, long exhausted overseas, should be withdrawn in turn.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this.

sentences.zh: 應昌疏稱：「釜山雖瀕海南，猶朝鮮境，有如倭覘我罷兵，突入再犯，朝鮮不支，前功盡棄。

translations.literal: Song Yingchang memorialized: "Although Busan borders the sea to the south, it is still Korean territory; if the Wa observe our withdrawal of troops and suddenly invade again, Korea cannot hold out and all previous gains will be lost.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yingchang memorialized: "Although Busan borders the sea to the south, it is still Korean territory; if the Wa observe our withdrawal of troops and suddenly invade again, Korea cannot hold out and all previous gains will be lost.

sentences.zh: 今撥兵協守為第一策，即議撤，宜少需，俟倭盡歸，量留防戍。

translations.literal: Now assigning troops for joint defense is the first strategy; even if withdrawal is deliberated, a short delay is appropriate, waiting until the Wa have all returned, then leaving a measured garrison force.
translations.idiomatic: Assigning troops for joint defense is the best course; even if withdrawal is contemplated, a short delay is appropriate—wait until the Wa have all returned, then leave a measured garrison force.

sentences.zh: 」部議留江浙兵五千，分屯要害，仍諭昖搜練軍實，毋恃外援。

translations.literal: " The ministry deliberated leaving five thousand Jiangsu and Zhejiang troops, garrisoned at strategic points, and still instructed Seon to search out and drill military strength and not rely on external aid.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry deliberated leaving five thousand Jiangsu and Zhejiang troops garrisoned at strategic points and instructed Seon to search out and drill his military strength and not rely on external aid.

sentences.zh: 已而沈惟敬歸自釜山，同倭使來請款，而倭隨犯咸安、晉州，逼全羅，聲復漢江以南，以王京、漢江為界。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Shen Weijing returned from Busan together with a Wa envoy to request peace, but the Wa then invaded Haman and Jinju, pressed into Jeolla, and declared they would recover the territory south of the Han River, with the royal capital and the Han River as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Shen Weijing returned from Busan together with a Wa envoy to sue for peace, but the Wa then invaded Haman and Jinju, pressed into Jeolla, and declared they would recover the territory south of the Han River, with the royal capital and the Han River as the boundary.

sentences.zh: 如松計全羅饒沃，南原府尤其咽喉，乃命諸將分守要害。

translations.literal: Rusong calculated that Jeolla was rich and fertile and that Namwon prefecture was especially its vital pass; he thereupon ordered the generals to divide and hold strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: Rusong judged Jeolla rich and fertile and Namwon prefecture especially its vital pass; he ordered the generals to divide forces and hold the strategic points.

sentences.zh: 已，倭果分犯，我師並有斬獲。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the Wa indeed divided forces to invade; our armies both killed and captured.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Wa indeed divided forces to invade, and our armies both killed and captured the enemy.

sentences.zh: 兵科給事中張輔之、遼東都御史趙耀皆言款貢不可輕受。

translations.literal: Supervising secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhang Fuzhi and Liaodong censor-in-chief Zhao Yao both stated that peace overtures and tribute should not be lightly accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhang Fuzhi and Liaodong censor-in-chief Zhao Yao both argued that peace overtures and tribute should not be lightly accepted.

sentences.zh: 七月，倭從釜山移西生浦，送回王子、陪臣。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Wa moved from Busan to Saseongpo and returned the princes and attendant ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Wa moved from Busan to Saseongpo and returned the princes and attendant ministers.

sentences.zh: 時師久暴露，聞撤，勢難久羈。

translations.literal: At that time the army had long been exposed to the elements; hearing of withdrawal, it was difficult to keep them long restrained.
translations.idiomatic: The army had long been exposed to the elements; on hearing of withdrawal, it was difficult to keep them under restraint much longer.

sentences.zh: 應昌請留劉綎川兵，吳惟忠、駱尚志等南兵，合薊、遼兵共萬六千，聽綎分佈尚之大丘，月餉五萬兩，資之戶兵二部。

translations.literal: Song Yingchang requested leaving Liu Ting's Sichuan troops, Wu Weizhong, Luo Shangzhi, and other southern troops, together with Ji and Liaodong troops totaling sixteen thousand; Ting was to distribute them with Shangzhi at Daegu; monthly rations of fifty thousand taels were to be supplied by the Ministries of Revenue and War.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yingchang requested leaving Liu Ting's Sichuan troops together with Wu Weizhong, Luo Shangzhi, and other southern troops, combined with Ji and Liaodong troops totaling sixteen thousand; Ting was to distribute them with Shangzhi at Daegu, with monthly rations of fifty thousand taels supplied by the Ministries of Revenue and War.

sentences.zh: 先是，發帑給軍費，已累百萬。

translations.literal: Previously, disbursements from the treasury for military expenses had already totaled more than a million.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, disbursements from the treasury for military expenses had already totaled more than a million taels.

sentences.zh: 廷臣言虛內實外非長策，請以所留川兵命綎訓練，兵餉令本國自辦。

translations.literal: Court officials stated that emptying the interior to strengthen the exterior was no long-term strategy; they requested that the Sichuan troops left behind be ordered to train under Ting, and military rations be supplied by the host country itself.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials argued that emptying the interior to strengthen the exterior was no long-term strategy; they requested that the Sichuan troops left behind be placed under Ting for training and that military rations be supplied by Korea itself.

sentences.zh: 於是詔撤惟忠等兵，止留綎兵防守。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered withdrawal of Wu Weizhong's troops and others, leaving only Ting's troops for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict ordered the withdrawal of Wu Weizhong's troops and others, leaving only Ting's troops for defense.

sentences.zh: 諭朝鮮世子臨海君珒居全慶，以顧養謙為經略。

translations.literal: The Korean heir apparent Imhaegun Jeong was instructed to reside at Jeonju, and Gu Yangqian was made strategic coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: The Korean heir apparent Imhaegun Jeong was instructed to reside at Jeonju, and Gu Yangqian was appointed strategic coordinator.

sentences.zh: 九月，昖以三都既復，疆域再造，上表謝恩。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Seon, because the three capitals had been recovered and the realm restored, submitted a memorial of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Seon, because the three capitals had been recovered and the realm restored, submitted a memorial of thanks.

sentences.zh: 然時倭猶據釜山也，星益一意主款。

translations.literal: Yet at that time the Wa still held Busan; Shi Xing increasingly insisted on peace alone.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at that time the Wa still held Busan, and Shi Xing increasingly insisted on peace alone.

sentences.zh: 九月，兵部主事曾偉芳言：「關白大眾已還，行長留待。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Bureau of Military Affairs section chief Zeng Weifang stated: "The regent's main force has already returned; Yukinaga remains waiting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Bureau of Military Affairs section chief Zeng Weifang stated: "The regent's main force has already returned; Yukinaga remains waiting.

sentences.zh: 知我兵未撤，不敢以一矢加遺。

translations.literal: Knowing our troops have not withdrawn, he dares not add a single arrow to the remnant force.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing our troops have not withdrawn, he dares not add a single arrow to the remnant force.

sentences.zh: 欲歸報關白捲土重來，則風不利，正苦冬寒。

translations.literal: If he wishes to return and report to the regent to gather his forces and come again, the winds are unfavorable and he suffers from the winter cold.
translations.idiomatic: If he wishes to return and report to the regent to gather his forces and come again, the winds are unfavorable and he suffers from the winter cold.

sentences.zh: 故款亦去，不款亦去。

translations.literal: Therefore whether there is peace or not, he will leave.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore whether there is peace or not, he will leave.

sentences.zh: 沈惟敬前于倭營講購，咸安、晉州隨陷，而俗恃款冀來年不攻，則速之款者，正速之來耳。

translations.literal: Previously Shen Weijing negotiated purchase in the Wa camp; Haman and Jinju then fell; yet the people relied on peace hoping for no attack next year—then those who hasten peace are precisely those who hasten the coming attack.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Shen Weijing negotiated purchase in the Wa camp, and Haman and Jinju then fell; yet the people relied on peace hoping for no attack next year—those who hasten peace are precisely those who hasten the coming attack.

sentences.zh: 故款亦來，不款亦來。

translations.literal: Therefore whether there is peace or not, he will come.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore whether there is peace or not, he will come.

sentences.zh: 宜令朝鮮自為守，吊死問孤，練兵積粟，以圖自強。

translations.literal: Korea should be ordered to defend itself, comfort the dead and inquire after the orphaned, drill troops and store grain, and plan self-strengthening.
translations.idiomatic: Korea should be ordered to defend itself, comfort the dead and inquire after the orphaned, drill troops and store grain, and plan to strengthen itself.

sentences.zh: 」帝以為然，因敕諭昖者甚至。

translations.literal: " The emperor thought this correct and therefore issued edicts instructing Seon to an extraordinary degree.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thought this correct and issued edicts instructing Seon to an extraordinary degree.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月，昖遣金晬等進方物謝恩。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-second year Seon dispatched Kim Chun and others to present local products in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-second year Seon dispatched Kim Chun and others to present local products in thanks.

sentences.zh: 禮部郎中何喬遠奏：「晬涕泣言倭寇猖獗，朝鮮束手受刃者六萬餘人。

translations.literal: Bureau director of the Ministry of Rites He Qiaoyuan memorialized: "Chun wept and stated that the Wa pirates were rampant; more than sixty thousand in Korea had helplessly submitted to the blade.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau director of the Ministry of Rites He Qiaoyuan memorialized: "Chun wept and stated that the Wa pirates were rampant; more than sixty thousand people in Korea had helplessly submitted to the blade.

sentences.zh: 倭語悖慢無禮，沈惟敬與倭交通，不雲和親，輒曰乞降。

translations.literal: Wa speech was insolent and without propriety; Shen Weijing communicated with the Wa; not speaking of marriage alliance, he immediately spoke of begging surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wa speech was insolent and without propriety; Shen Weijing communicated with the Wa; instead of speaking of marriage alliance, he spoke of begging surrender.

sentences.zh: 臣謹將萬曆十九年中國被掠人許儀所寄內地書、倭夷答劉綎書及歷年入寇處置之宜，乞特敕急止封貢。

translations.literal: Your subject respectfully submits the letter from the interior sent by Xu Yi, a Chinese captive in the nineteenth year of Wanli, the Wa barbarians' reply to Liu Ting, and the proper disposition of raids over the years; begging a special edict urgently to stop investiture and tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject respectfully submits the letter from the interior sent by Xu Yi, a Chinese captive in the nineteenth year of Wanli, the Wa barbarians' reply to Liu Ting, and the proper disposition of raids over the years, and begs for a special edict urgently stopping investiture and tribute.

sentences.zh: 」詔兵部議。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the Ministry of War to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Ministry of War to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 時廷臣交章，皆以罷封貢、議戰守為言。

translations.literal: At that time court officials submitted memorial after memorial, all speaking of stopping investiture and tribute and deliberating war and defense.
translations.idiomatic: At that time court officials submitted memorial after memorial, all arguing to stop investiture and tribute and to deliberate war and defense.

sentences.zh: 八月，養謙奏講貢之說，貢道宜從寧波，關白宜封為日本王，諭行長部倭盡歸，與封貢如約。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Yangqian memorialized on the plan for tribute negotiations; the tribute route should be from Ningbo; the regent should be enfeoffed as King of Japan; Yukinaga's Wa forces should be instructed to all return, and investiture and tribute should proceed as agreed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yangqian memorialized on the plan for tribute negotiations: the tribute route should be from Ningbo; the regent should be enfeoffed as King of Japan; Yukinaga's Wa forces should be instructed to all return, and investiture and tribute should proceed as agreed.

sentences.zh: 九月，昖請許保國。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Seon requested permission to preserve the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Seon requested permission to preserve the state.

sentences.zh: 帝乃切責群臣阻撓，追褫御史郭實等。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon sharply rebuked the officials for obstruction and stripped Censor Guo Shi and others of their posts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon sharply rebuked the officials for obstruction and stripped Censor Guo Shi and others of their posts.

sentences.zh: 詔小西飛入朝，集多官面議，要以三事：一，勒倭盡歸巢；

translations.literal: An edict summoned Konishi Hi to court; many officials were assembled for face-to-face deliberation, requiring three matters: first, compel the Wa to all return to their nests;
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned Konishi Hi to court; many officials were assembled for face-to-face deliberation, requiring three matters: first, compel the Wa to all return home;

sentences.zh: 一，既封不與貢；

translations.literal: second, once enfeoffed, no tribute is granted;
translations.idiomatic: second, once enfeoffed, no tribute is granted;

sentences.zh: 一，誓無犯朝鮮。

translations.literal: third, swear not to violate Korea.
translations.idiomatic: third, swear not to violate Korea.

sentences.zh: 倭俱聽從，以聞。

translations.literal: The Wa all obeyed; this was reported.
translations.idiomatic: The Wa all agreed; this was reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝復諭于左闕，語加周復。

translations.literal: The emperor again instructed at the Left Gate; his words were thorough and repeated.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again instructed at the Left Gate, his words thorough and repeated.

sentences.zh: 十二月，封議定，命臨淮侯李宗城充正使，以都指揮楊方亨副之，同沈惟敬往日本，王給金印，行長授都督僉事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the investiture plan was settled; Marquis of Linhuai Li Zongcheng was appointed chief envoy, with Regional Commander Yang Fangheng as deputy, together with Shen Weijing to go to Japan; the king was given a gold seal; Yukinaga was granted the post of assistant regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the investiture plan was settled; Marquis of Linhuai Li Zongcheng was appointed chief envoy, with Regional Commander Yang Fangheng as deputy, together with Shen Weijing to go to Japan; the king was given a gold seal and Yukinaga was granted the post of assistant regional commander.

sentences.zh: 二十三年九月，昖奏立次子琿為嗣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-third year Seon memorialized to establish his second son Hui as heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twenty-third year Seon memorialized to establish his second son Hui as heir.

sentences.zh: 先是，昖庶長子臨海君珒陷賊中，驚憂成疾，次子光海君琿收集流散，頗著功績，奏請立之。

translations.literal: Previously Seon's eldest son by a concubine, Imhaegun Jeong, was trapped among the enemy; alarm and grief became illness; the second son Gwanghaegun Hui gathered the scattered and achieved considerable merit; a memorial requested he be established.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Seon's eldest son by a concubine, Imhaegun Jeong, had been trapped among the enemy and fell ill from alarm and grief; the second son Gwanghaegun Hui gathered the scattered population and achieved considerable merit, and a memorial requested that he be established as heir.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書范謙言繼統大義，長幼定分，不宜僭差，遂不許。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Fan Qian stated the great principle of succession, that elder and younger have fixed order and should not be improperly altered; thereupon permission was denied.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Fan Qian cited the great principle of succession—that elder and younger have a fixed order and should not be improperly altered—and permission was denied.

sentences.zh: 至是復奏，引永樂間恭定王例上請，禮臣執奏，不從。

translations.literal: At this time a memorial was again submitted, citing the precedent of King Gongding in the Yongle period; the rites officials firmly memorialized and it was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: At this time a memorial was again submitted, citing the precedent of King Gongding in the Yongle period; the rites officials firmly memorialized in opposition and it was not approved.

sentences.zh: 二十四年五月，昖復疏請立琿，禮部仍執不可，詔如議。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-fourth year Seon again memorialized requesting establishment of Hui; the Ministry of Rites still firmly held it impossible; an edict followed the deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-fourth year Seon again memorialized requesting that Hui be established as heir; the Ministry of Rites still firmly opposed it, and an edict followed their deliberation.

sentences.zh: 時國儲未建，中外恫疑，故尚書范謙于朝鮮易封事三疏力持雲。

translations.literal: At that time no heir to the state had been established and there was alarm and doubt at court and abroad; therefore, on the matter of Korea's requested change of succession, Minister Fan Qian submitted three memorials firmly maintaining his position.
translations.idiomatic: At that time no heir to the state had been established and there was alarm and doubt at court and abroad; therefore, on the matter of Korea's requested change of succession, Minister Fan Qian submitted three memorials firmly maintaining his dissent.

sentences.zh: 九月，封使至日本。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the investiture envoys reached Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the investiture envoys arrived in Japan.

sentences.zh: 先是，沈惟敬抵釜山，私奉秀吉蟒玉、翼善冠、地圖、武經、良馬。

translations.literal: Previously, Shen Weijing reached Busan and on his own authority presented Hideyoshi with python-pattern jade, the Yishan cap, maps, military treatises, and fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, Shen Weijing reached Busan and on his own authority presented Hideyoshi with python-pattern jade ornaments, the Yishan cap, maps, military treatises, and fine horses.

sentences.zh: 而李宗城以貪淫為倭守臣所逐，棄璽書夜遁。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Li Zongcheng, for greed and licentiousness, was driven off by the Wa garrison officials; he abandoned the imperial seal and credentials and fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Li Zongcheng, for greed and licentiousness, was driven off by the Wa garrison officials; he abandoned the imperial seal and credentials and fled under cover of night.

sentences.zh: 事聞，逮問。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was arrested and interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, he was arrested and brought to trial.

sentences.zh: 乃以方亨充正使，加惟敬神機營銜副之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Fangheng was appointed chief envoy, and Weijing was added as deputy with the title of the Divine Engine Corps.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Yang Fangheng was appointed chief envoy, with Shen Weijing added as deputy bearing the rank of the Divine Engine Corps.

sentences.zh: 及是奉冊至，關白怒朝鮮王子不來謝，止遣二使奉白土綢為賀，拒其使不見，語惟敬曰：「若不思二子、三大臣、三都、八道悉遵天朝約付還，今以卑官微物來賀，辱小邦邪？

translations.literal: When the investiture credentials arrived, the regent was enraged that the Korean prince had not come to give thanks; only two envoys were sent offering white silk earth cloth as congratulation. He refused to receive the envoys and told Weijing: "If you do not consider that the two princes, the three ministers, the three capitals, and the eight provinces should all be returned according to the Celestial Court's agreement, and now come to congratulate with a low-ranking official and trivial gifts, is this to insult our small state?
translations.idiomatic: When the investiture credentials arrived, the regent was enraged that the Korean prince had not come to give thanks and sent only two envoys bearing white silk earth cloth as congratulation. He refused to receive the envoys and told Weijing, "If you do not intend that the two princes, the three ministers, the three capitals, and the eight provinces all be returned as the Celestial Court agreed, and now send a low-ranking official with trivial gifts to congratulate us, is this meant to insult our small state?

sentences.zh: 辱天朝邪？

translations.literal: Or to insult the Celestial Court?
translations.idiomatic: Or to insult the Celestial Court?"

sentences.zh: 且留石曼子兵於彼，候天朝處分，然後撤還。

translations.literal: Moreover, leave Ishimanzhi's troops there, await disposition from the Celestial Court, and then withdraw them.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, leave Ishimanzhi's troops there until the Celestial Court decides, and only then withdraw them.

sentences.zh: 」翌日奉貢，遣使齎表文二道，隨冊使渡海至朝鮮。

translations.literal: " The next day he presented tribute and dispatched envoys bearing two memorials, crossing the sea with the investiture envoys to Korea.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he presented tribute and dispatched envoys bearing two memorials, crossing the sea with the investiture envoys to Korea.

sentences.zh: 廷議遣使於朝鮮，取表文進驗，其一謝恩，其一乞天子處分朝鮮。

translations.literal: The court deliberated on dispatching envoys to Korea to take the memorials and submit them for verification: one expressing thanks, the other requesting the Son of Heaven's disposition of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberated on dispatching envoys to Korea to retrieve the memorials and submit them for verification—one expressing thanks, the other requesting the Son of Heaven's disposition of Korea.

sentences.zh: 初，方亨詭報去年從釜山渡海，倭於大版受封，即回和泉州。

translations.literal: Initially Fangheng had falsely reported that last year, crossing the sea from Busan, the Wa received investiture at Osaka and immediately returned to Izumi.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Fangheng had falsely reported that the previous year, after crossing the sea from Busan, the Wa received investiture at Osaka and immediately returned to Izumi.

sentences.zh: 然倭方責備朝鮮，仍留兵釜山如故，謝表後時不發，方亨徒手歸。

translations.literal: Yet the Wa were still pressing Korea, still keeping troops at Busan as before; the thank-you memorial was slow to be issued, and Fangheng returned empty-handed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Wa were still pressing Korea and keeping troops at Busan as before; the thank-you memorial was slow in coming, and Fangheng returned empty-handed.

sentences.zh: 至是，惟敬始投表文，案驗潦草，前折用豐臣圖書，不奉正朔，無人臣禮。

translations.literal: At this point Weijing at last submitted the memorials; examination found them careless; earlier they had used Toyotomi's own documents, did not observe the correct calendar, and lacked the courtesies due a subject.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Weijing at last submitted the memorials; examination found them careless—they had used Toyotomi's own documents, did not observe the correct calendar, and lacked the courtesies due a subject.

sentences.zh: 而寬奠副總兵馬楝報清正擁二百艘屯機張營。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Kuandian deputy regional commander Ma Dong reported that Kiyomasa held two hundred ships encamped at Gijang.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Kuandian deputy regional commander Ma Dong reported that Kiyomasa had two hundred ships encamped at Gijang.

sentences.zh: 方亨始直吐本末，委罪惟敬，並呈石星前後手書。

translations.literal: Fangheng at last told the whole story plainly, shifted blame onto Weijing, and also submitted Shi Xing's letters before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Fangheng at last told the whole story plainly, shifted the blame onto Weijing, and also submitted Shi Xing's letters from before and after.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，命逮石星、沈惟敬案問。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly enraged and ordered Shi Xing and Shen Weijing arrested and interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly enraged and ordered Shi Xing and Shen Weijing arrested and brought to trial.

sentences.zh: 以兵部尚書邢玠總督薊、遼；

translations.literal: Minister of War Xing Jie was made grand coordinator of Ji and Liaodong;
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Xing Jie was appointed grand coordinator of Ji and Liaodong;

sentences.zh: 改麻貴為備倭大將軍，經理朝鮮；

translations.literal: Ma Gui was reassigned as Great General for Preparedness against Wa, to administer Korea;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gui was reassigned as Great General for Preparedness against Wa to administer Korea;

sentences.zh: 僉都御史楊鎬駐天津，申警備；

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Yang Hao was stationed at Tianjin to raise the alarm on defense;
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Yang Hao was stationed at Tianjin to raise the alarm and strengthen defenses;

sentences.zh: 楊汝南、丁應泰贊畫軍前。

translations.literal: Yang Runnan and Ding Yingtai served as staff planners at the front.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Runnan and Ding Yingtai served as staff planners at the front.

sentences.zh: 五月，玠至遼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Xing Jie reached Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Xing Jie reached Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 行長建樓，清正布種，島倭窖水，索朝鮮地圖，玠遂決意用兵。

translations.literal: Yukinaga built towers, Kiyomasa planted crops, the island Wa stored water, and they demanded Korean maps; Xing Jie thereupon resolved on military action.
translations.idiomatic: Yukinaga built towers, Kiyomasa planted crops, the island Wa stockpiled water, and they demanded Korean maps; Xing Jie thereupon resolved to take military action.

sentences.zh: 麻貴望鴨綠江東發，所統兵僅萬七千人，請濟師。

translations.literal: Ma Gui looked to advance from the east of the Yalu River, but the troops under his command numbered only seventeen thousand; he requested reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gui looked to advance from the east bank of the Yalu River, but the troops under his command numbered only seventeen thousand; he requested reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 玠以朝鮮兵惟嫻水戰，乃疏請募兵川、浙，並調薊、遼、宣、大、山、陝兵及福建、吳淞水師，劉綎督川、漢兵聽剿。

translations.literal: Xing Jie, considering that Korean troops were skilled only in naval combat, memorialized requesting recruitment from Sichuan and Zhejiang, and also mobilized troops from Ji, Liaodong, Xuanfu, Datong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi, and the Fujian and Wusong naval forces, with Liu Ting directing Sichuan and Han troops for extermination duty.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jie, judging that Korean troops were skilled only in naval combat, memorialized requesting recruitment from Sichuan and Zhejiang and also mobilized troops from Ji, Liaodong, Xuanfu, Datong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi, along with the Fujian and Wusong naval forces, assigning Liu Ting to direct Sichuan and Han troops for extermination duty.

sentences.zh: 貴密報候宣、大兵至，乘倭未備，掩釜山，則行長擒，清正走。

translations.literal: Gui secretly reported that when the Xuanfu and Datong troops arrived, they should strike Busan while the Wa were unprepared—then Yukinaga would be captured and Kiyomasa would flee.
translations.idiomatic: Gui secretly reported that when the Xuanfu and Datong troops arrived, they should strike Busan while the Wa were unprepared—then Yukinaga would be captured and Kiyomasa would flee.

sentences.zh: 玠以為奇計，乃檄楊元屯南原，吳惟忠屯忠州。

translations.literal: Xing Jie regarded this as a brilliant stratagem and issued orders for Yang Yuan to encamp at Namwon and Wu Weizhong at Chungju.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jie regarded this as a brilliant stratagem and ordered Yang Yuan to encamp at Namwon and Wu Weizhong at Chungju.

sentences.zh: 六月，倭數千艘泊釜山，戮朝鮮郡守安弘國，漸逼梁山、熊川。

translations.literal: In the sixth month several thousand Wa ships anchored at Busan, executed Korean prefect An Hongguo, and gradually pressed toward Yangsan and Ungcheon.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month several thousand Wa ships anchored at Busan, executed the Korean prefect An Hongguo, and gradually pressed toward Yangsan and Ungcheon.

sentences.zh: 惟敬率營兵二百，出入釜山。

translations.literal: Weijing led two hundred camp soldiers in and out of Busan.
translations.idiomatic: Weijing led two hundred camp soldiers in and out of Busan.

sentences.zh: 玠陽為慰藉，檄楊元襲執之，縛至貴營，惟敬執而嚮導始絕。

translations.literal: Xing Jie feigned consolation while ordering Yang Yuan to seize him in a surprise raid; he was bound and sent to Gui's camp, and with Weijing's capture the guiding liaison was finally cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jie feigned consolation while ordering Yang Yuan to seize him in a surprise raid; Weijing was bound and sent to Gui's camp, and with his capture the guiding liaison was finally severed.

sentences.zh: 七月，倭奪梁山、三浪，遂入慶州，侵閑山。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Wa took Yangsan and Sannang, then entered Gyeongju and invaded Hansan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Wa took Yangsan and Sannang, then entered Gyeongju and invaded Hansan.

sentences.zh: 統制元均兵潰，遂失閑山。

translations.literal: Commander Won Gyun's army collapsed, and Hansan was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Won Gyun's army collapsed, and Hansan was lost.

sentences.zh: 閑山島在朝鮮西海口，右障南原，為全羅外籓，一失守則沿海無備，天津、登、萊皆可揚帆而至。

translations.literal: Hansan Island lies at Korea's western sea mouth, shielding Namwon on the right; it was Jeolla's outer defense—once lost the coast had no protection, and Tianjin, Dengzhou, and Laizhou could all be reached under sail.
translations.idiomatic: Hansan Island lay at Korea's western sea mouth, shielding Namwon on the right as Jeolla's outer defense; once it fell the coast was undefended, and Tianjin, Dengzhou, and Laizhou could all be reached under sail.

sentences.zh: 而我水兵三千甫抵旅順，閑山破，經略檄守王京西之漢江、大同江，扼倭西下，兼防運道。

translations.literal: Our three thousand naval troops had just reached Lüshun when Hansan fell; the grand coordinator issued orders to hold the Han River and Taedong River west of the royal capital, blocking the Wa from descending westward while also guarding the supply routes.
translations.idiomatic: Our three thousand naval troops had just reached Lüshun when Hansan fell; the grand coordinator ordered troops to hold the Han River and Taedong River west of the royal capital, blocking the Wa from descending westward while also guarding the supply routes.

sentences.zh: 八月，清正圍南原，乘夜猝攻，守將楊元遁。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Kiyomasa besieged Namwon and struck suddenly by night; defending general Yang Yuan fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Kiyomasa besieged Namwon and struck suddenly by night; the defending general Yang Yuan fled.

sentences.zh: 時全州有陳愚衷，去南原僅百里，南原告急，愚衷不敢救，聞已破，棄城走。

translations.literal: At that time Chen Enzhong was at Jeonju, only a hundred li from Namwon; Namwon urgently called for aid, but Enzhong dared not rescue it, and when he heard it had fallen he abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chen Enzhong was at Jeonju, only a hundred li from Namwon; Namwon urgently called for aid, but Enzhong dared not go to its rescue, and when he heard it had fallen he abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 麻貴遣遊擊牛伯英赴援，與愚衷合兵，屯公州。

translations.literal: Ma Gui dispatched raiding colonel Niu Boying to aid them; he joined Enzhong's forces and encamped at Gongju.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gui dispatched raiding colonel Niu Boying to aid them; Boying joined Enzhong's forces and encamped at Gongju.

sentences.zh: 倭遂犯全慶，逼王京。

translations.literal: The Wa then invaded Jeolla and Gyeongsang and pressed toward the royal capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Wa then invaded Jeolla and Gyeongsang and pressed toward the royal capital.

sentences.zh: 王京為朝鮮八道之中，東阻烏嶺、忠州，西則南原、全州，道相通。

translations.literal: The royal capital stood at the center of Korea's eight provinces; to the east it was blocked by Wolyeong and Chungju, to the west lay Namwon and Jeonju, with roads linking them.
translations.idiomatic: The royal capital stood at the center of Korea's eight provinces; to the east it was blocked by Wolyeong and Chungju, to the west lay Namwon and Jeonju, with roads linking them.

sentences.zh: 自二城失，東西皆倭，我兵單弱，因退守王京，依險漢江。

translations.literal: Since the two cities were lost, Wa forces lay east and west; our troops were few and weak, so we withdrew to hold the royal capital, taking the Han River's natural defenses.
translations.idiomatic: With both cities lost, Wa forces lay to east and west; our troops were few and weak, so we withdrew to hold the royal capital, taking the Han River's natural defenses.

sentences.zh: 麻貴請於玠欲棄王京退守鴨綠江。

translations.literal: Ma Gui asked Xing Jie about abandoning the royal capital and withdrawing to defend the Yalu River.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gui asked Xing Jie about abandoning the royal capital and withdrawing to defend the Yalu River.

sentences.zh: 海防使蕭應宮以為不可，自平壤兼程趨王京止之。

translations.literal: Coastal defense commissioner Xiao Yinggong held this impossible and raced from Pyongyang by forced marches to the royal capital to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal defense commissioner Xiao Yinggong held this impossible and raced from Pyongyang by forced marches to the royal capital to stop it.

sentences.zh: 麻貴發兵守稷山，朝鮮亦調都體察使李元翼由烏嶺出忠清道遮賊鋒。

translations.literal: Ma Gui sent troops to hold Mt. Jiri; Korea also mobilized provincial inspector Li Yuanyi to go out through Wolyeong into Chungcheong route to block the enemy vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gui sent troops to hold Mt. Jiri; Korea also mobilized provincial inspector Li Yuanyi to go out through Wolyeong into Chungcheong route to block the enemy vanguard.

sentences.zh: 玠既身赴王京，人心始定。
