translations.literal: Once Xing Jie himself went to the royal capital, people's hearts began to settle.
translations.idiomatic: Once Xing Jie himself went to the royal capital, morale began to settle.

sentences.zh: 玠召參軍李應試問計，應試請問廟廷主畫雲何。

translations.literal: Xing Jie summoned staff officer Li Yingxi to ask his plan; Yingxi requested to know what the court's chief strategy was.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jie summoned staff officer Li Yingxi to ask his plan; Yingxi asked what the court's chief strategy was.

sentences.zh: 玠曰：「陽戰陰和，陽剿陰撫，政府八字密畫，無泄也。

translations.literal: Xing Jie said: "Openly fight but secretly treat for peace; openly exterminate but secretly pacify—the government has eight confidential characters for its plan; do not leak them.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jie said, "Openly fight but secretly treat for peace; openly exterminate but secretly pacify—the government has eight confidential characters for its plan; do not leak them.

sentences.zh: 應試曰：「然則易耳。

translations.literal: Yingxi said: "Then it is easy.
translations.idiomatic: Yingxi said, "Then it is easy.

sentences.zh: 倭叛以處分絕望，其不敢殺楊元，猶望處分也。

translations.literal: The Wa rebel because they despair of receiving disposition; that they dare not kill Yang Yuan shows they still hope for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: The Wa rebel because they despair of receiving disposition; that they dare not kill Yang Yuan shows they still hope for disposition.

sentences.zh: 直使人諭之曰沈惟敬不死，則退矣。

translations.literal: Simply send someone to tell them: if Shen Weijing is not dead, they will withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Simply send someone to tell them: if Shen Weijing is not dead, they will withdraw.

sentences.zh: 」因請使李大諫于行長，馮仲纓於清正，玠從之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he requested that Li Dajian be sent to Yukinaga and Feng Zhongying to Kiyomasa; Xing Jie agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he requested that Li Dajian be sent to Yukinaga and Feng Zhongying to Kiyomasa; Xing Jie agreed.

sentences.zh: 九月，倭至漢江，楊鎬遣張貞明持惟敬手書往，責其動兵，有乖靜候處分之實。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Wa reached the Han River; Yang Hao sent Zhang Zhenming with Weijing's handwritten letter, reproaching them for moving troops, which belied quietly awaiting disposition.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Wa reached the Han River; Yang Hao sent Zhang Zhenming with Weijing's handwritten letter, reproaching them for moving troops in violation of quietly awaiting disposition.

sentences.zh: 行長、正成亦尤清正輕舉，乃退屯井邑。

translations.literal: Yukinaga and Seisei also blamed Kiyomasa for reckless action, and they withdrew to encamp at Jeup.
translations.idiomatic: Yukinaga and Seisei also blamed Kiyomasa for reckless action and withdrew to encamp at Jeup.

sentences.zh: 麻貴遂報青山、稷山大捷。

translations.literal: Ma Gui thereupon reported great victories at Cheongsan and Mt. Jiri.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gui thereupon reported great victories at Cheongsan and Mt. Jiri.

sentences.zh: 蕭應宮揭言：「倭以惟敬手書而退，青山、稷山並未接戰，何得言功？

translations.literal: Xiao Yinggong publicly stated: "The Wa withdrew because of Weijing's handwritten letter; at Cheongsan and Mt. Jiri there was no engagement at all—how can victory be claimed?
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yinggong publicly stated, "The Wa withdrew because of Weijing's handwritten letter; at Cheongsan and Mt. Jiri there was no engagement at all—how can victory be claimed?

sentences.zh: 」玠、鎬怒，遂劾應宮恇怯，不親解惟敬，並逮。

translations.literal: " Xing Jie and Hao were enraged and memorialized against Yinggong for cowardice and for not personally securing Weijing's release; he was arrested as well.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jie and Hao were enraged and memorialized against Yinggong for cowardice and for not personally securing Weijing's release; he was arrested as well.

sentences.zh: 十一月，玠徵兵大集，帝發帑金犒軍，賜玠尚方劍，而以御史陳效監其軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Xing Jie gathered a great muster of troops; the emperor issued treasury gold to reward the army, granted Xing Jie the imperial sword, and appointed censor Chen Xiao to supervise the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Xing Jie gathered a great muster of troops; the emperor issued treasury gold to reward the army, granted Xing Jie the imperial sword, and appointed censor Chen Xiao to supervise the army.

sentences.zh: 玠大會諸將，分三協。

translations.literal: Xing Jie held a great assembly of generals and divided them into three wings.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jie held a great assembly of generals and divided them into three wings.

sentences.zh: 鎬同貴率左右協，自忠州、烏嶺向東安，趨慶州，專攻清正。

translations.literal: Hao together with Gui led the left and right wings from Chungju and Wolyeong toward Dongan, pressing to Gyeongju, concentrating the attack on Kiyomasa.
translations.idiomatic: Hao together with Gui led the left and right wings from Chungju and Wolyeong toward Dongan, pressing to Gyeongju to concentrate the attack on Kiyomasa.

sentences.zh: 使李大諫通行長，約勿往援。

translations.literal: Li Dajian was sent to Yukinaga with an agreement not to go to aid him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dajian was sent to Yukinaga with an agreement not to go to his aid.

sentences.zh: 復遣中協屯宜城，東援慶州，西扼全羅。

translations.literal: The center wing was again dispatched to encamp at Uiseong, aiding Gyeongju to the east and blocking Jeolla to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The center wing was again dispatched to encamp at Uiseong, aiding Gyeongju to the east and blocking Jeolla to the west.

sentences.zh: 以餘兵會朝鮮合營，詐攻順天等處，以牽制行長東援。

translations.literal: The remaining troops joined the Korean combined camp and feigned attacks on Suncheon and other places to tie down Yukinaga's eastern relief.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining troops joined the Korean combined camp and feigned attacks on Suncheon and other places to tie down Yukinaga's eastern relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月，會慶州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they assembled at Gyeongju.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month they assembled at Gyeongju.

sentences.zh: 麻貴遣黃慶賜賄清正約和，而率大兵奄至其營。

translations.literal: Ma Gui sent Huang Qing with bribes to Kiyomasa to arrange peace, while leading a large force to suddenly arrive at his camp.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gui sent Huang Qing with bribes to Kiyomasa to arrange peace while leading a large force to suddenly arrive at his camp.

sentences.zh: 時倭屯蔚山，城依山險，中一江通釜寨，其陸路由彥陽通釜山。

translations.literal: At that time the Wa were encamped at Ulsan; the city leaned on mountain defenses, with a river in the middle connecting to the Busan stockade; the land route passed through Uiryeong to Busan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Wa were encamped at Ulsan; the city leaned on mountain defenses, with a river in the middle connecting to the Busan stockade, and the land route passed through Uiryeong to Busan.

sentences.zh: 貴欲專攻蔚山，恐釜倭由彥陽來援，乃多張疑兵，又遣將遏其水路，遂進逼倭壘。

translations.literal: Gui wished to concentrate on attacking Ulsan; fearing Busan Wa would come to aid via Uiryeong, he deployed many feints and also sent generals to block their water route, then advanced to press the Wa fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: Gui wished to concentrate on attacking Ulsan; fearing Busan Wa would come to aid via Uiryeong, he deployed many feints, sent generals to block their water route, and then advanced to press the Wa fortifications.

sentences.zh: 遊擊擺寨以輕騎誘倭入伏，斬級四百餘，獲其勇將，乘勝拔兩柵。

translations.literal: The raiding colonel deployed camps and used light cavalry to lure the Wa into an ambush, beheading more than four hundred, capturing their brave general, and taking advantage of victory to seize two palisades.
translations.idiomatic: The raiding colonel deployed camps and used light cavalry to lure the Wa into an ambush, beheading more than four hundred, capturing their brave general, and seizing two palisades in the momentum of victory.

sentences.zh: 倭焚死者無算，遂奔島山，連築三寨。

translations.literal: Countless Wa died in the fires; they then fled to Dolsan and built three camps in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Countless Wa died in the fires; they then fled to Dolsan and built three camps in succession.

sentences.zh: 翌日，遊擊茅國器統浙兵先登，連破之，斬獲甚多，倭堅壁不出。

translations.literal: The next day raiding colonel Mao Guoqi leading Zhejiang troops mounted first, broke through in succession, with many beheaded and captured; the Wa held their walls and did not come out.
translations.idiomatic: The next day raiding colonel Mao Guoqi leading Zhejiang troops mounted the assault first, broke through in succession with many beheaded and captured, and the Wa held their walls and did not come out.

sentences.zh: 島山視蔚山高，石城堅甚，我師仰攻多損傷。

translations.literal: Dolsan overlooked Ulsan and was higher; the stone walls were very strong; our army attacking upward suffered many casualties.
translations.idiomatic: Dolsan overlooked Ulsan and stood higher; the stone walls were very strong, and our army attacking upward suffered many casualties.

sentences.zh: 諸將乃議曰：「倭艱水道，餉難繼，第坐困之，清正可不戰縛也。

translations.literal: The generals then deliberated: "The Wa lack water routes; supplies are hard to sustain—simply sit and wear them down, and Kiyomasa can be bound without battle.
translations.idiomatic: The generals then deliberated, "The Wa lack water routes and supplies are hard to sustain—simply sit and wear them down, and Kiyomasa can be bound without battle.

sentences.zh: 」鎬等以為然，分兵圍十日夜，倭饑甚，偽約降緩攻。

translations.literal: " Hao and others agreed; troops were divided to besiege for ten day-nights; the Wa were very hungry and falsely promised surrender to slow the attack.
translations.idiomatic: Hao and others agreed; troops were divided to besiege for ten day-nights; the Wa were very hungry and falsely promised surrender to slow the attack.

sentences.zh: 俄行長援兵大至，將繞出軍後。

translations.literal: Suddenly Yukinaga's relief force arrived in great strength and was about to swing around behind the army.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly Yukinaga's relief force arrived in great strength and was about to swing around behind the army.

sentences.zh: 鎬不及下令，策馬西奔，諸軍皆潰。

translations.literal: Hao had no time to issue orders; he spurred his horse and fled west, and all the armies collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Hao had no time to issue orders; he spurred his horse and fled west, and all the armies collapsed.

sentences.zh: 遂撤兵還王京，士卒物故者二萬。

translations.literal: They thereupon withdrew to the royal capital; twenty thousand soldiers had perished.
translations.idiomatic: They thereupon withdrew to the royal capital; twenty thousand soldiers had perished.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，震怒。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard, he was shaken with rage.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard, he was shaken with rage.

sentences.zh: 乃罷鎬聽勘，以天津巡撫萬世德代。

translations.literal: Hao was dismissed pending investigation, and Tianjin grand coordinator Wan Shide was appointed in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Hao was dismissed pending investigation, and Tianjin grand coordinator Wan Shide was appointed in his place.

sentences.zh: 事詳《鎬傳》。

translations.literal: Details are in the biography of Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Details are in the biography of Hao.

sentences.zh: 二十六年正月，邢玠以前役乏水兵無功，乃益募江南水兵，議海運，為持久計。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-sixth year Xing Jie, because the previous campaign had lacked naval troops and achieved nothing, further recruited Jiangnan naval soldiers, deliberated on sea transport, and planned for a protracted struggle.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-sixth year Xing Jie, because the previous campaign had lacked naval troops and achieved nothing, further recruited Jiangnan naval soldiers, deliberated on sea transport, and planned for a protracted struggle.

sentences.zh: 二月，都督陳璘以廣兵，劉綎以川兵，鄧子龍以浙、直兵先後至。

translations.literal: In the second month Regional Commander Chen Lin arrived with Guangdong troops, Liu Ting with Sichuan troops, and Deng Zilong with Zhejiang and Zhili troops, arriving in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Regional Commander Chen Lin arrived with Guangdong troops, Liu Ting with Sichuan troops, and Deng Zilong with Zhejiang and Zhili troops, arriving in succession.

sentences.zh: 玠分兵三協，為水陸四路，路置大將。

translations.literal: Xing Jie divided troops into three wings, forming four routes by land and water, each route with a senior commander.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jie divided troops into three wings, forming four routes by land and water, each route with a senior commander.

sentences.zh: 中路如梅，東路貴，西路綎，水路璘，各守汛地，相機行剿。

translations.literal: The center route was Li Rumei, the east route Gui, the west route Ting, and the water route Lin; each held their assigned sector and acted on opportunity to exterminate.
translations.idiomatic: The center route was Li Rumei, the east route Gui, the west route Ting, and the water route Lin; each held their assigned sector and acted on opportunity to exterminate the enemy.

sentences.zh: 時倭亦分三窟。

translations.literal: At that time the Wa also divided into three lairs.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Wa also divided into three lairs.

sentences.zh: 東路則清正，據蔚山。

translations.literal: The east route was Kiyomasa, holding Ulsan.
translations.idiomatic: The east route was Kiyomasa, holding Ulsan.

sentences.zh: 西路則行長，據粟林、曳橋，建砦數重。

translations.literal: The west route was Yukinaga, holding Awlin and Yegeo, building several layers of forts.
translations.idiomatic: The west route was Yukinaga, holding Awlin and Yegeo and building several layers of forts.

sentences.zh: 中路則石曼子，據泗州。

translations.literal: The center route was Ishimanzhi, holding Sacheon.
translations.idiomatic: The center route was Ishimanzhi, holding Sacheon.

sentences.zh: 而行長水師番休濟餉，往來如駛。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Yukinaga's navy rotated shifts to supply provisions, coming and going like flying arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Yukinaga's navy rotated shifts to supply provisions, coming and going like flying arrows.

sentences.zh: 我師約日並進，尋報遼陽警，李如松敗沒，詔如梅還赴之，中路以董一元代。

translations.literal: Our army agreed to advance on the same day; soon came word of an alarm at Liaoyang and that Li Rusong had been defeated and killed; an edict ordered Rumei to return to meet it, and Dong Yiyuan replaced him on the center route.
translations.idiomatic: Our army agreed to advance on the same day; soon came word of an alarm at Liaoyang and that Li Rusong had been defeated and killed; an edict ordered Rumei to return to meet it, and Dong Yiyuan replaced him on the center route.

sentences.zh: 當應泰之劾鎬也，昖請回乾斷，崇勵鎮撫，以畢征討。

translations.literal: When Yingtai memorialized against Hao, Seon requested restored imperial decision, exalted encouragement and pacification, to complete the punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingtai memorialized against Hao, Seon requested restored imperial decision and exalted encouragement and pacification to complete the punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 上不許。

translations.literal: The emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 又應泰曾以築城之議為鎬罪案，謂堅城得志，啟朝鮮異日之患，於是昖奏辨。

translations.literal: Moreover Yingtai had made fortification proposals part of Hao's criminal case, stating that strong walls gratified ambition and would open Korea's future troubles; Seon thereupon memorialized in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Yingtai had made fortification proposals part of Hao's criminal case, stating that strong walls gratified ambition and would open Korea to future troubles; Seon thereupon memorialized in defense.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「連年用兵發餉，以爾國素效忠順故也，毋以人言自疑。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Year after year we have deployed troops and issued supplies because your state has long shown loyal obedience; do not let others' words make you doubt yourselves."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Year after year we have deployed troops and issued supplies because your state has long shown loyal obedience; do not let others' words make you doubt yourselves."

sentences.zh: 九月，將士分道進兵，劉綎進逼行長營，約行長為好會。

translations.literal: In the ninth month officers and soldiers advanced by separate routes; Liu Ting pressed close to Yukinaga's camp and arranged a friendly meeting with Yukinaga.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month officers and soldiers advanced by separate routes; Liu Ting pressed close to Yukinaga's camp and arranged a friendly meeting with him.

sentences.zh: 翌日，攻城，斬首九十二。

translations.literal: The next day they assaulted the city and beheaded ninety-two.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they assaulted the city and beheaded ninety-two.

sentences.zh: 陳璘舟師協堵擊，毀倭船百餘。

translations.literal: Chen Lin's fleet joined in blocking and striking, destroying more than a hundred Wa ships.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Lin's fleet joined in blocking and striking, destroying more than a hundred Wa ships.

sentences.zh: 行長潛出千餘騎扼之，綎不利，退，璘亦棄舟走。

translations.literal: Yukinaga secretly sent out more than a thousand cavalry to block them; Ting fared poorly and withdrew, and Lin also abandoned his ships and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yukinaga secretly sent out more than a thousand cavalry to block them; Ting fared poorly and withdrew, and Lin also abandoned his ships and fled.

sentences.zh: 麻貴至蔚山，頗有斬獲，倭偽退誘之。

translations.literal: Ma Gui reached Ulsan and had considerable beheadings and captures; the Wa feigned retreat to lure him.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gui reached Ulsan and had considerable beheadings and captures; the Wa feigned retreat to lure him.

sentences.zh: 貴入空壘，伏兵起，遂敗。

translations.literal: Gui entered the empty fort; ambush troops rose, and he was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Gui entered the empty fort; ambush troops rose, and he was defeated.

sentences.zh: 董一元進取晉州，乘勝渡江，連毀二寨。

translations.literal: Dong Yiyuan advanced to take Jinju, crossed the river on the momentum of victory, and destroyed two camps in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Yiyuan advanced to take Jinju, crossed the river on the momentum of victory, and destroyed two camps in succession.

sentences.zh: 倭退保泗州老營，鏖戰下之，前逼新寨。

translations.literal: The Wa retreated to hold Sacheon's old camp; after fierce fighting it was taken, and they pressed forward to the new camp.
translations.idiomatic: The Wa retreated to hold Sacheon's old camp; after fierce fighting it was taken, and they pressed forward to the new camp.

sentences.zh: 寨三面臨江，一面通陸，引海為濠，海艘泊寨下千計，築金海、固城為左右翼。

translations.literal: The camp faced the river on three sides and connected to land on one; seawater was drawn in as a moat; a thousand sea vessels moored beneath the camp; Jinhae and Goseong were fortified as left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: The camp faced the river on three sides and connected to land on one; seawater was drawn in as a moat; a thousand sea vessels moored beneath the camp; Jinhae and Goseong were fortified as left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 十月，董一元遣將四面攻城，用火器擊碎寨門，兵競前拔柵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Dong Yiyuan dispatched generals to assault the city from four sides; fire weapons shattered the camp gates and troops rushed forward in competition to seize the palisades.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Dong Yiyuan dispatched generals to assault the city from four sides; fire weapons shattered the camp gates and troops rushed forward to seize the palisades.

sentences.zh: 忽營中火藥崩，煙焰漲天。

translations.literal: Suddenly in the camp gunpowder exploded; smoke and flames surged to the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Without warning, gunpowder in the camp detonated, and smoke and fire billowed skyward.

sentences.zh: 倭乘勢衝擊，固城倭亦至，兵遂大潰，奔還晉州。

translations.literal: The Wa seized the momentum to charge; Wa from Goseong also arrived, and the army then collapsed in great rout and fled back to Jinju.
translations.idiomatic: The Japanese forces pressed the attack; reinforcements from Goseong joined them, and the Ming army broke completely and fled back to Jinju.

sentences.zh: 帝聞，命斬二遊擊以徇，一元等各帶罪立功。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard, he ordered two mobile-commanders beheaded as a warning; Yiyuan and the others were each to redeem guilt by achieving merit.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing this, the Emperor ordered two detached commanders executed as an example; Dong Yiyuan and the rest were ordered to win back their honor through service.

sentences.zh: 是月，福建都御史金學曾報七月九日平秀吉死，各倭俱有歸志。

translations.literal: That month, Fujian provincial surveillance commissioner Jin Xuezeng reported that on the ninth day of the seventh month Hideyoshi had died and all the Wa were inclined to return.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jin Xuezeng, provincial surveillance commissioner of Fujian, reported that Hideyoshi had died on the ninth day of the seventh month and that the Japanese troops were ready to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 十一月，清正發舟先走，麻貴遂入島山、酉浦，劉綎攻奪曳橋。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Kiyomasa launched his boats and left first; Ma Gui then entered Island Mountain and Yupo, and Liu Ting attacked and seized Yegyo Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Kato Kiyomasa sailed away ahead of the others; Ma Gui advanced into Island Mountain and Yupo, while Liu Ting stormed and took Yegyo Bridge.

sentences.zh: 石曼子引舟師救行長，陳璘邀擊敗之。

translations.literal: Ishida Mitsunari led a fleet to rescue Yukinaga; Chen Lin intercepted, struck, and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Ishida Mitsunari brought a naval force to relieve Konishi Yukinaga, but Chen Lin intercepted and routed him.

sentences.zh: 諸倭揚帆盡歸。

translations.literal: All the Wa raised sail and fully returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Japanese forces hoisted sail and sailed home.

sentences.zh: 自倭亂朝鮮七載，喪師數十萬，糜餉數百萬，中朝與屬國迄無勝算，至關白死而禍始息。

translations.literal: From the Wa disturbance in Korea for seven years, armies lost numbered in the hundreds of thousands and supplies consumed in the millions; the central court and the tributary state had no winning plan until the kampaku died and the calamity began to cease.
translations.idiomatic: The war in Korea had lasted seven years, costing hundreds of thousands of lives and millions in supplies, and neither the Ming nor its ally had found a path to victory—until Hideyoshi’s death finally brought the disaster to an end.

sentences.zh: 二十七年閏四月，以平倭詔告天下，又敕諭昖曰：「倭奴平秀吉肆為不道，蹂躪爾邦。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month of the twenty-seventh year an edict announcing the pacification of the Wa was proclaimed to the realm, and an imperial instruction was also sent to Seonjo, saying: "The Wa slave Hideyoshi has wantonly committed outrage and trampled your state."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month of year twenty-seven the court proclaimed to the empire that the Japanese invasion had been pacified, and the Emperor also addressed Seonjo: "The Japanese brigand Hideyoshi committed outrageous crimes and ravaged your kingdom."

sentences.zh: 朕念王世篤忠貞，深用憫惻。

translations.literal: I reflect that Your Majesty has been deeply loyal and upright, and I am deeply moved to compassion.
translations.idiomatic: I have long regarded Your Majesty as steadfast in loyalty and integrity, and my heart is full of compassion for your suffering.

sentences.zh: 七年之中，日以此賊為事。

translations.literal: Throughout seven years, day by day this bandit was the business.
translations.idiomatic: For seven years this enemy was the business that occupied us day after day.

sentences.zh: 始行薄伐，繼示包容，終加嚴討。

translations.literal: At first a light punitive campaign was launched, then forbearance was shown, and finally strict punishment was imposed.
translations.idiomatic: We began with a limited punitive expedition, then offered forbearance, and at last brought down stern retribution.

sentences.zh: 蓋不殺乃天之心，而用兵非予得已。

translations.literal: For it is Heaven’s heart not to kill, yet to employ arms was not what I could avoid.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven’s way is to spare life, yet I had no choice but to take up arms.

sentences.zh: 安疆靖亂，宜取蕩平。

translations.literal: To secure the borders and quell disorder, complete pacification should be taken.
translations.idiomatic: To secure the frontier and restore peace, nothing less than total pacification would suffice.

sentences.zh: 神惡凶盈，陰殲魁首，大師乘之，追奔逐北，鯨鯢盡戮，海隅載清，捷書來聞，憂勞始釋。

translations.literal: The spirits hate overflowing evil; in secret the ringleader was destroyed; the great army seized the moment, pursued the fleeing foe northward, whales and minnows were all slaughtered, the seacoast was cleared throughout, victory reports arrived, and worry and toil began to be released.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven abhors those whose wickedness overflows; the chief culprit was struck down in secret. Our great army seized the moment, pursued the fleeing enemy, and destroyed them root and branch until the coast was clear. When the victory dispatches arrived, my cares at last began to lift.

sentences.zh: 惟王雖還舊物，實同新造，振凋起敝，為力倍艱。

translations.literal: Although Your Majesty has recovered your former possessions, it is in truth like a new creation; to revive the withered and rouse the worn is twice as arduous in effort.
translations.idiomatic: Though you have regained your realm, it is as though you must build it anew; to revive a ruined land demands redoubled effort.

sentences.zh: 倭雖遁歸，族類尚在。

translations.literal: Although the Wa have fled home, their kindred remain.
translations.idiomatic: The Japanese may have withdrawn, but their people remain.

sentences.zh: 茲命邢玠振旅歸京，量留萬世德等分佈戍守。

translations.literal: Now Xing Jie is ordered to lead the army back to the capital; Wan Shide and others are to remain in measured numbers posted for garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jie is now ordered to bring the army home to the capital, while Wan Shide and others are to remain in designated strength as garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 王宜臥薪嚐膽，無忘前恥，惟忠惟孝，纘紹前休。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should sleep on brushwood and taste gall, not forget former shame, be only loyal and only filial, and continue the former glory.
translations.idiomatic: You must endure hardship and never forget this humiliation; through loyalty and filial piety, carry on the glory of your forebears.

sentences.zh: 」五月，玠條陳東征善後事宜十事。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month Jie set forth in items ten matters for the aftermath of the eastern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Xing Jie memorialized ten proposals for managing the aftermath of the eastern expedition.

sentences.zh: 一，留戍兵，馬步水陸共計三萬四千有奇，馬三千匹。

translations.literal: First, retain garrison troops: infantry and cavalry, land and water, totaling more than thirty-four thousand, with three thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: First, retain garrison forces: more than thirty-four thousand troops on land and sea, with three thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 一，定月餉，每年計銀九十一萬八千有奇。

translations.literal: Second, fix monthly rations: silver totaling more than 918,000 taels per year.
translations.idiomatic: Second, set monthly pay at more than 918,000 taels of silver per year.

sentences.zh: 一，定本色，合用米豆，分派遼東、天津、山東等處，每年十三萬石。

translations.literal: Third, fix staple goods: rice and beans required, apportioned from Liaodong, Tianjin, Shandong, and other places, 130,000 piculs per year.
translations.idiomatic: Third, fix grain supplies: rice and beans totaling 130,000 piculs yearly, to be levied from Liaodong, Tianjin, Shandong, and other regions.

sentences.zh: 一，留中路海防道。

translations.literal: Fourth, retain the central-route maritime defense intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, keep the central-route maritime defense intendant in post.

sentences.zh: 一，裁餉司。

translations.literal: Fifth, abolish the provisions bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, abolish the supply bureau.

sentences.zh: 一，重將領。

translations.literal: Sixth, give weight to commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, strengthen the authority of field commanders.

sentences.zh: 一，添巡捕。

translations.literal: Seventh, add patrol units.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, add patrol forces.

sentences.zh: 一，分汛地。

translations.literal: Eighth, divide guard zones.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, divide coastal defense sectors.

sentences.zh: 一，議操練。

translations.literal: Ninth, discuss drill and training.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, institute regular military training.

sentences.zh: 一，責成本國。

translations.literal: Tenth, hold the host country responsible for costs.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth, require the Korean court itself to bear the costs.

sentences.zh: 廷臣議：「數年疲耗，今始息肩，自宜內固根本，不當更為繁費。

translations.literal: Court officials deliberated: "Years of exhaustion and drain have only now brought relief to the shoulders; it is fitting to consolidate the root within, and one should not incur further heavy expense."
translations.idiomatic: The court debated: "After years of strain the empire has only just caught its breath; we should strengthen our foundations at home rather than take on new burdens."

sentences.zh: 況彼國兵荒之後，不獨苦倭之擾，兼苦我兵。

translations.literal: Moreover, after war and famine in that country, they suffer not only from Wa harassment but also from our troops.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Korea after war and famine has suffered not only from the Japanese but also from the presence of our own armies.

sentences.zh: 故今日善後事宜，仍當商之彼國，先量彼餉之贏絀，始可酌我兵之去留。

translations.literal: Therefore today’s aftermath measures should still be negotiated with that country; first measure whether their supplies are in surplus or deficit, and only then may our troops’ withdrawal or retention be weighed.
translations.idiomatic: The proper course is to consult Korea first, assess whether their resources can sustain a garrison, and only then decide how many Ming troops should remain.

sentences.zh: 至於增買馬匹，添補標兵，創立巡捕，及至管餉府佐，悉宜停止。

translations.literal: As for increasing horse purchases, adding standard troops, establishing patrol units, and even supply officials at the prefectural level, all should cease.
translations.idiomatic: Purchasing more horses, adding banner troops, creating patrol units, and appointing supply officials should all be halted.

sentences.zh: 」帝命督撫會同國王酌奏。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered the grand coordinators and the king jointly to deliberate and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the grand coordinators and the Korean king to consult and report jointly.

sentences.zh: 八月，昖獻方物，助大工，褒賞如例。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Seonjo presented local products to assist the great works, and rewards were bestowed as usual.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Seonjo sent tribute goods to support imperial construction projects and received the customary rewards in return.

sentences.zh: 十月，請留水兵八千，以資戍守。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he requested that eight thousand naval troops be retained to support garrison defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he asked that eight thousand naval troops be left behind for coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 其撤回官兵，駐劄遼陽備警。

translations.literal: The withdrawn officers and soldiers were to be stationed at Liaoyang on alert.
translations.idiomatic: The troops being withdrawn were stationed at Liaoyang to stand ready against emergencies.

sentences.zh: 二十八年四月請將義州等倉遺下米豆運回遼陽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-eighth year he requested that rice and beans left in storehouses at Uiju and elsewhere be transported back to Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year twenty-eight he asked that surplus rice and beans in warehouses at Uiju and other places be shipped back to Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 戶部議：「輸運維艱，莫若徑與彼國，振其雕敝，以昭皇仁。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue deliberated: "Transport is difficult; it would be better to give them directly to that country, revive their exhaustion, and thereby display imperial benevolence."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue advised: "The cost of transport is prohibitive; better to leave the grain in Korea to relieve their distress and display the Emperor’s mercy."

translations.literal: The edict said: "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "Let it be so."

sentences.zh: 二十九年二月，兵部覆奏經督條陳七事：「一，練兵士。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-ninth year the Ministry of War reported back on seven items set forth by the grand coordinator: "First, drill soldiers."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year twenty-nine the Ministry of War responded to seven proposals from the grand coordinator: "First, train the troops."

sentences.zh: 麗人鷙悍耐寒苦，而長衫大袖，訓練無方，宜以束伍之法教之。

translations.literal: Koreans are fierce and endure cold hardship, yet wear long gowns and wide sleeves and lack method in training; they should be taught by the method of binding units into fives and tens.
translations.idiomatic: Koreans are hardy and endure hardship well, but their long robes and wide sleeves reflect undisciplined training; they should be drilled using the squad-and-platoon system.

sentences.zh: 一，守沖要。

translations.literal: Second, guard strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: Second, defend critical positions.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮三面距海，釜山與對馬相望，巨濟次之，宜各守以重兵，並蔚山、開山等處皆宜戍守。

translations.literal: Korea is bounded by sea on three sides; Pusan faces Tsushima across the water, Geoje is next in importance—each should be held with heavy forces—and Ulsan, Gyeongju, and other places should all be garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Korea is surrounded by sea on three sides; Pusan, facing Tsushima, and Geoje, the next key harbor, each require strong garrisons, as do Ulsan, Gyeongju, and other vulnerable points.

sentences.zh: 一，修險隘。

translations.literal: Third, repair narrow passes.
translations.idiomatic: Third, fortify mountain defiles.

sentences.zh: 王京北倚叢山，南環滄海。

translations.literal: The capital leans on clustered mountains to the north and is ringed by the blue sea to the south.
translations.idiomatic: Seoul rests against mountains to the north and is encircled by sea to the south.

sentences.zh: 忠州左右烏、竹二嶺，羊腸繞曲，有一夫當關之險。

translations.literal: To the left and right of Chungju are the Wu and Zhu passes; goat-paths wind and curve, with the peril of one man holding the pass.
translations.idiomatic: East and west of Chungju lie the Wu and Zhu ridges, where winding goat-tracks offer the classic chokepoint where a single defender can block an army.

sentences.zh: 今營壘遺址尚存，亟宜修葺。

translations.literal: The sites of former camps and ramparts still remain; they should urgently be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Remnants of old fortifications still stand there and should be restored without delay.

sentences.zh: 一，建城池。

translations.literal: Fourth, build walled cities.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, construct walled cities.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮八道，十九無城。

translations.literal: Of Korea’s eight provinces, nineteen lack cities.
translations.idiomatic: Of Korea’s eight provinces, cities are absent in nineteen districts.

sentences.zh: 平壤西北鴨、浿二江，俱南通海。

translations.literal: Northwest of Pyongyang the Ya and Pae rivers both connect southward to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest of Pyongyang the Yalu and Taedong rivers both run south to the sea.

sentences.zh: 倘倭別遣一旅佔據平壤，則王京聲援斷絕，皆應修築屯聚。

translations.literal: If the Wa should send a separate detachment to occupy Pyongyang, contact with the capital would be cut off; all should be fortified and garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: If the Japanese landed a separate force at Pyongyang, Seoul would be isolated; fortifications and garrisons should be built accordingly.

sentences.zh: 一，造器械。

translations.literal: Fifth, manufacture weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, produce arms and equipment.

sentences.zh: 倭戰便陸不便海，以船制重大，不利攻擊。

translations.literal: The Wa are skilled on land and unskilled at sea; their ships are made heavy and are ill-suited to attack.
translations.idiomatic: The Japanese fight well on land but poorly at sea; their vessels are built heavy and clumsy for offensive action.

sentences.zh: 今准福唬造百十艘為奇兵，並添造神機百子火箭。

translations.literal: Now approval is given for Fuhu to build a hundred-odd vessels as striking forces, and additionally to add divine-engine hundred-bolt rockets.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved building more than a hundred swift warships as a strike force, along with additional divine-engine rocket batteries.

sentences.zh: 一，訪異材。

translations.literal: Sixth, seek extraordinary talent.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, recruit men of exceptional ability.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮貴世官，賊世役，一切禁錮，往往走倭走敵，為本國患，宜破格搜采。

translations.literal: Korea honors hereditary office and binds hereditary corvée; all are confined, and many flee to the Wa or to the enemy and become a scourge to their own state—talent should be sought by breaking the usual rules.
translations.idiomatic: Korea’s hereditary aristocracy and bound labor service trap talent in rigid ranks, driving many to defect to Japan or to the enemy; officials should be recruited without regard to conventional restrictions.

sentences.zh: 一，修內治。

translations.literal: Seventh, repair internal governance.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, strengthen domestic administration.

sentences.zh: 國家東南臨海，以登、旅為門戶，鎮江為咽喉，應援之兵，不宜盡撤。

translations.literal: Our state faces the southeastern sea; Dengzhou and Lüshun are the gateway, Zhenjiang the throat; relief troops should not all be withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming southeastern coast faces the sea; Dengzhou and Lüshun are its gateway and Zhenjiang its throat; relief forces should not be fully withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 我自固，亦所以固朝鮮也。

translations.literal: In securing ourselves we also secure Korea.
translations.idiomatic: By strengthening our own defenses we protect Korea as well.

sentences.zh: 」詔朝鮮刻勵以行。

translations.literal: " An edict urged Korea to engrave this counsel and carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: The court issued an edict instructing Korea to take these measures to heart and implement them.

sentences.zh: 九月，奏所頒誥命冕服遭變淪失，祈補給，從之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he memorialized that the bestowed patent of appointment, regalia, and robes had been lost in the upheaval and requested replacement; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he reported that imperial patents, robes, and regalia had been lost in the war and asked for replacements; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 時倭國內亂，對馬島主平義智悉遣降人還朝鮮，遺書乞和，且揚言秀吉將家康將輸糧數十萬石為軍興資，以脅朝鮮。

translations.literal: At the time Japan was torn by internal strife; the lord of Tsushima, Konishi Yoshitoshi, sent all surrendered men back to Korea, left a letter begging peace, and spread word that generals of Hideyoshi and Ieyasu would deliver hundreds of thousands of piculs of grain as funds for renewing the war, to coerce Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Japan was then riven by civil disorder. The lord of Tsushima, So Yoshitoshi, returned all prisoners to Korea, sent a letter suing for peace, and threatened that Hideyoshi’s and Tokugawa Ieyasu’s forces would supply hundreds of thousands of piculs of grain to renew hostilities unless Korea complied.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮與對馬島一水相望，島地不產五穀，資米於朝鮮。

translations.literal: Korea and Tsushima are separated by a strip of water; the island produces no grain and relies on Korea for rice.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Tsushima are divided only by a narrow strait; the island grows no grain and depends on Korean rice.

sentences.zh: 兵興後，絕開市，因百計脅款。

translations.literal: After the war began, markets were closed, and therefore they used every scheme to extort a settlement.
translations.idiomatic: Trade had ceased with the outbreak of war, and the Japanese resorted to every form of coercion to reopen it.

sentences.zh: 秀吉死，我軍盡撤，朝鮮畏倭滋甚。

translations.literal: When Hideyoshi died our army fully withdrew, and Korea feared the Wa all the more.
translations.idiomatic: After Hideyoshi’s death the Ming armies withdrew entirely, and Korea’s fear of Japan only deepened.

sentences.zh: 欲與倭通款，又懼開罪中國。

translations.literal: They wished to treat with the Wa, yet feared offending China.
translations.idiomatic: They wished to negotiate with Japan but feared offending the Ming.

sentences.zh: 十二月，昖以島倭求款來請命。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Seonjo, because island Wa sought a settlement, came to request instructions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Seonjo asked the court for guidance, reporting that the Japanese of Tsushima were seeking a negotiated peace.

sentences.zh: 兵部以事難遙度，令總督世德酌議，詔可。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War, holding that the matter was hard to judge from afar, ordered Grand Coordinator Wan Shide to deliberate as he saw fit; the edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War, unable to judge the matter from a distance, ordered Wan Shide to decide on the spot; the Emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 三十年十一月，昖言倭使頻來要脅和款，兵端漸露，乞選將率兵，督同本國訓練修防。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the thirtieth year Seonjo stated that Japanese envoys came repeatedly demanding a negotiated peace, that hostilities were gradually reappearing, and begged that generals be selected to lead troops and supervise training and defense together with his own state.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year thirty Seonjo reported that Japanese envoys were pressing repeatedly for peace talks while signs of renewed conflict appeared, and he asked that Ming generals be sent to train and fortify Korea alongside his own forces.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「曾留將士教習，成法具在，無容再遣。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Generals were once left to instruct them; established methods are all in place—there is no room to send again."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "We have already left officers to train your forces, and the established procedures remain in place; we cannot send another mission."

sentences.zh: 因命其使臣齎敕誡勵。

translations.literal: He therefore ordered their envoys to carry an imperial letter of admonition and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: He instead had their envoys carry back an imperial edict of admonition and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 三十三年九月，昖復請封琿為世子，禮部仍執立長之議。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirty-third year Seonjo again requested that Hui be enfeoffed as heir apparent; the Ministry of Rites still held to the principle of establishing the eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year thirty-three Seonjo again asked that Gwanghae be named heir apparent, but the Ministry of Rites still insisted on the rule of primogeniture.

sentences.zh: 三十五年四月，昖以家康求和來告，兵部議聽王自計而已。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-fifth year Seonjo reported that Ieyasu was seeking peace; the Ministry of War deliberated that the king should be left to devise his own plan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year thirty-five Seonjo informed the court that Tokugawa Ieyasu was suing for peace; the Ministry of War decided to let the king manage the matter himself.

sentences.zh: 由是和款不絕，後三年始畫開市之事。

translations.literal: Hence negotiated peace was unbroken, and only three years later was the matter of reopening markets finally settled.
translations.idiomatic: Negotiations continued without a break, and trade was not formally reopened until three years later.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，昖卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year Seonjo died.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-six Seonjo died.

sentences.zh: 光海君琿自稱署國事，追陪臣來訃，且請諡。

translations.literal: Gwanghaegun Hui styled himself as administering state affairs, sent mourning envoys, and also requested a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: Gwanghae-gun Hui declared himself regent, sent envoys to announce the death, and asked for a posthumous title for the late king.

sentences.zh: 帝惡其擅，不允，令該國臣民公義以聞。

translations.literal: The Emperor detested his usurpation and did not approve, ordering that the officials and people of that country deliberate publicly and report.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor disapproved of this presumption and refused consent, instructing Korea’s officials and people to decide the matter through public deliberation and report back.

sentences.zh: 時我大清兵征服各部，漸近朝鮮。

translations.literal: At the time our Great Qing army was conquering the various tribes and gradually approaching Korea.
translations.idiomatic: By then the armies of the rising Qing were subduing the Jurchen tribes and drawing ever nearer to Korea.

sentences.zh: 兵部議令該王大修武備，整飭邊防，並請敕遼左督撫鎮臣，遣官宣達毋相侵犯之意。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated that the king of that country should greatly repair military preparations and put border defense in order, and also requested an edict to the grand coordinators and commanders of eastern Liaodong to send officials to proclaim the intent that neither side should violate the other.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War urged the Korean king to rebuild his defenses and tighten the frontier, and asked that eastern Liaodong officials be instructed to send envoys making clear that neither side should encroach on the other.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，封琿為國王，從其臣民請也。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Hui was enfeoffed as king, following the request of his officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Gwanghae was invested as king, as his court and people had petitioned.

sentences.zh: 三十七年二月，諡昖曰昭敬，遣官賜琿及妃柳氏誥命。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-seventh year Seonjo was given the posthumous title Zhaojing, and officials were dispatched to bestow patents of appointment on Hui and his consort Lady Liu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year thirty-seven Seonjo received the posthumous title Zhaojing, and envoys were sent to invest Gwanghae and his consort Lady Liu with imperial patents.

sentences.zh: 初，朝鮮失守，賴中國力得復，倭棄釜山遁。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Korea lost its territory, it relied on China’s strength to recover it; the Wa abandoned Pusan and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Korea had been overrun, it was only through Ming power that the kingdom was restored and the Japanese driven from Pusan.

sentences.zh: 然陰謀啟疆，為患不已。

translations.literal: Yet secret designs to open territory made trouble without end.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Japan’s covert ambitions to expand its foothold brought unending trouble.

sentences.zh: 於是海上流言倭圖釜山，朝鮮與之通。

translations.literal: Thereupon rumors on the sea said the Wa intended Pusan and that Korea was in communication with them.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors then spread along the coast that Japan was plotting against Pusan and that Korea was colluding with them.

sentences.zh: 四十一年九月，總兵官楊宗業以聞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the forty-first year regional commander Yang Zongye reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year forty-one Regional Commander Yang Zongye reported these rumors to the court.

sentences.zh: 琿疏辨，詔慰解之。

translations.literal: Hui memorialized in defense; an edict comforted and cleared him.
translations.idiomatic: Gwanghae submitted a defense; the Emperor issued an edict reassuring him and dismissing the charge.

sentences.zh: 四十二年四月，奏請追封生母金氏。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the forty-second year he memorialized requesting posthumous enfeoffment for his birth mother, the Lady Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year forty-two he asked that his biological mother, Lady Jin, be granted posthumous rank.

sentences.zh: 禮部按《會典》，嫡母受封而生母先亡者得追贈，乃命封為國王次妃。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites, following the 《Collected Statutes》, held that when the principal wife received enfeoffment and the birth mother had already died, posthumous grant was permitted, and he was ordered enfeoffed as the king’s secondary consort.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites, citing the 《Collected Statutes》, ruled that when the principal consort held rank and the birth mother was deceased, posthumous ennoblement was permitted, and Lady Jin was granted the title of the king’s secondary consort.

sentences.zh: 四十三年十一月，表賀冬至，因奏買回《吾學編》、《弇山堂別集》等書，載本國事與《會典》乖錯，乞改正。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the forty-third year, in a memorial congratulating the winter solstice, he also memorialized buying back books such as 《Wuxue bian》, 《Yanshan tang bieji》, and others, which recorded affairs of his country in ways that conflicted with the 《Collected Statutes》, and begged correction.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year forty-three, in his winter-solstice tribute memorial, he also asked to purchase copies of 《Wuxue bian》, 《Yanshan tang bieji》, and other works that described Korean affairs in ways contradicting the 《Collected Statutes》, and requested that they be corrected.

sentences.zh: 禮部言：「野史不足憑。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites said: "Unofficial histories are not to be relied upon."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites replied: "Unofficial histories are not authoritative."

sentences.zh: 今所請恥與逆黨同譏，宜憫其誠，宣付史館。

translations.literal: What is requested now is shame at being classed with rebel factions in ridicule; his sincerity should be pitied and the matter forwarded to the Historiography Institute."
translations.idiomatic: Yet his request shows sincere distress at being lumped with rebels in those pages; the court should honor his earnestness and refer the matter to the Historiography Institute."

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: The reply approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 初，琿為生母已得封，至是復祈給冠服。

translations.literal: Earlier, Hui had already obtained enfeoffment for his birth mother; now he again begged that caps and robes be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Gwanghae had already secured posthumous rank for his mother; now he asked again for ceremonial caps and robes.

sentences.zh: 禮臣以金氏側室，禮有隆殺，執不可。

translations.literal: The ritual officials, holding that Lady Jin was a concubine and that ritual has gradations of elevation and reduction, firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials, noting that Lady Jin had been a concubine and that rites distinguish primary from secondary status, refused firmly.

sentences.zh: 四十五年正月，琿請至再，帝以琿屢次懇陳，勉從之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the forty-fifth year Hui petitioned again and again; the Emperor, because Hui had repeatedly pleaded earnestly, reluctantly consented.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year forty-five Gwanghae petitioned repeatedly; moved by his persistence, the Emperor at last yielded.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，楊鎬督馬林、杜松、劉綎等出師，為我大清兵所敗。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year Yang Hao, as grand coordinator, led Ma Lin, Du Song, Liu Ting, and others forth on campaign and was defeated by our Great Qing army.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-seven Grand Coordinator Yang Hao marched with Ma Lin, Du Song, Liu Ting, and others and was defeated by the Qing armies.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮助戰兵將，或降或戰死。

translations.literal: Korean troops who aided in the battle—some surrendered and some died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Among the Korean troops who fought alongside them, some surrendered and others died in battle.

sentences.zh: 琿告急，詔加優恤。

translations.literal: Hui reported an emergency; an edict granted additional generous relief.
translations.idiomatic: Hui reported an emergency, and an edict granted additional generous relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月，兵部覆：朝鮮入貢之道，宜添兵防守。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Ministry of War replied: on the route by which Korea presents tribute, additional troops should be posted for defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Ministry of War replied that additional troops should be posted to defend the route by which Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔鎮江等處設兵將，令經略熊廷弼調委。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that commanders and troops be stationed at Jinjiang and other places, to be assigned and deployed by the grand coordinator Xiong Tingbi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered commanders and troops posted at Jinjiang and other places, to be assigned and deployed by grand coordinator Xiong Tingbi.

sentences.zh: 四十八年正月，琿奏：「敵兵八月中攻破北關，金台吉自焚，白羊出降。

translations.literal: In the first month of the forty-eighth year Hui memorialized: "In the eighth month the enemy troops broke through the North Pass; Jin Taichi burned himself to death, and Baiyang surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the forty-eighth year Hui memorialized: "In the eighth month the enemy broke through the North Pass; Jin Taichi burned himself to death, and Baiyang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 鐵嶺之役，蒙古宰賽亦為所滅。

translations.literal: In the battle of Tieling the Mongol Zaisai was also destroyed by them.
translations.idiomatic: In the battle of Tieling the Mongol Zaisai was also destroyed by them.

sentences.zh: 聞其國謀議以朝鮮、北關、宰賽皆助兵南朝，今北關、宰賽皆滅，不可使朝鮮獨存。

translations.literal: It is heard that in their state they are deliberating that Korea, the North Pass, and Zaisai all sent troops to aid the Southern Court; now that the North Pass and Zaisai are both destroyed, Korea must not be allowed to survive alone.
translations.idiomatic: It was reported that their court was debating that Korea, the North Pass, and Zaisai had all sent troops to aid the Ming; now that the North Pass and Zaisai were both destroyed, Korea must not be allowed to stand alone.

sentences.zh: 又聞設兵牛毛寨、萬遮嶺，欲略寬奠、鎮江等處。

translations.literal: It is also heard that troops have been posted at Niumao Stockade and Wanzhe Ridge, intending to raid Gando and Jinjiang and other places.
translations.idiomatic: It was also reported that troops had been posted at Niumao Stockade and Wanzhe Ridge, intending to raid Gando, Jinjiang, and other places.

sentences.zh: 寬奠、鎮江與昌城、義州諸堡隔水相望，孤危非常。

translations.literal: Gando and Jinjiang face Changseong, Uiju, and the other forts across the water; they are extraordinarily isolated and imperiled.
translations.idiomatic: Gando and Jinjiang faced Changseong, Uiju, and the other forts across the water and were extraordinarily isolated and imperiled.

sentences.zh: 敵若從靉陽境上鴉鶻關取路繞出鳳凰城裏，一日長驅，寬鎮、昌城俱莫自保。

translations.literal: If the enemy take the route from Yaguguan on the Aiyang frontier and circle behind Fenghuangcheng, they can drive forward in a single day, and neither Gando-Jinjiang nor Changseong can be held.
translations.idiomatic: If the enemy took the route from Yaguguan on the Aiyang frontier and circled behind Fenghuangcheng, they could drive forward in a single day, and neither Gando-Jinjiang nor Changseong could be held.

sentences.zh: 內而遼左八站，外而東江一城，彼此隔斷，聲援阻絕，可為寒心。

translations.literal: Within, the eight Liaodong stations; without, the single city of the Eastern River—all cut off from one another, mutual support blocked: it is enough to chill the heart.
translations.idiomatic: Within lay the eight Liaodong stations; without, the lone city of the Eastern River—all cut off from one another with mutual support blocked, enough to chill the heart.

sentences.zh: 望速調大兵，共為掎角，以固邊防。

translations.literal: We hope great forces will quickly be shifted so that we may act in pincer together and secure the frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: We beg that great forces be shifted quickly so that we may act in mutual support and secure the frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 」時遼鎮塘報稱朝鮮與大清講和，朝議遂謂琿陽衡陰順，宜遣官宣諭，或命將監護，其說紛拿。

translations.literal: " At that time Liaodong frontier reports stated that Korea had made peace with the Great Qing; court deliberation then held that Hui was outwardly resistant but secretly compliant, and that an envoy should be dispatched to instruct him, or a general ordered to supervise—opinions were tangled and disputed.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Liaodong frontier reports stated that Korea had made peace with the Great Qing; court deliberation then held that Hui was outwardly resistant but secretly compliant, and that an envoy should be dispatched to instruct him or a general ordered to supervise—opinions were tangled and disputed.

sentences.zh: 琿疏辨：「二百年忠誠事大，死生一節。

translations.literal: Hui submitted a memorial in rebuttal: "For two hundred years we have served the great power with loyal devotion, one integrity in life and death.
translations.idiomatic: Hui submitted a memorial in rebuttal: "For two hundred years we have served the great power with loyal devotion, one integrity in life and death.

sentences.zh: 」詞極剴摯。

translations.literal: " The language was extremely earnest and sincere.
translations.idiomatic: " The language was extremely earnest and sincere.

sentences.zh: 禮、兵二部請降敕令曉諭，以安其心。

translations.literal: The Ministries of Rites and War requested that an imperial command be issued to instruct and reassure him and settle his mind.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministries of Rites and War requested that an imperial command be issued to instruct and reassure him.

sentences.zh: 帝是其議，然敕令陪臣往，不遣官也。

translations.literal: The emperor approved their proposal, yet the command was sent with Korean envoys; no official was dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved their proposal, yet the command was sent with Korean envoys and no official was dispatched.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年八月，改朝鮮貢道，自海至登州，直達京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Tianqi the Korean tribute route was changed: from the sea to Dengzhou, then straight to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Tianqi the Korean tribute route was changed to run from the sea to Dengzhou and then straight to the capital.

sentences.zh: 時毛文龍以總兵鎮皮島，招集逃民為兵，而仰給於朝鮮。

translations.literal: At that time Mao Wenlong as regional commander garrisoned Pidao, gathering fugitive civilians as troops and relying on Korea for supplies.
translations.idiomatic: At that time regional commander Mao Wenlong garrisoned Pidao, gathering fugitive civilians as troops and relying on Korea for supplies.

sentences.zh: 十一月，琿奏力難饋餉，乞循萬曆東征例，發運山東粟，從之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Hui memorialized that he could scarcely sustain provisions and requested that, following the precedent of the Wanli eastern campaign, grain be shipped from Shandong; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Hui memorialized that he could scarcely sustain provisions and requested that, following the precedent of the Wanli eastern campaign, grain be shipped from Shandong; approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，國人廢琿而立其侄綾陽君倧，以昭敬王妃之命權國事，令議政府移文督撫轉奏，文龍為之揭報。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year the people of the state deposed Hui and enthroned his nephew Ryangyanggun Jeong, who by order of Queen Dowager Zhaojing provisionally managed state affairs; the Council of State was ordered to send a dispatch to the grand coordinators for relay to the throne, and Wenlong reported it in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year the people deposed Hui and enthroned his nephew Ryangyanggun Jeong, who by order of Queen Dowager Zhaojing provisionally managed state affairs; the Council of State was ordered to send a dispatch to the grand coordinators for relay to the throne, and Wenlong reported it in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 登州巡撫袁可立上言：「琿果不道，宜聽太妃具奏，以待中國更立。

translations.literal: Dengzhou grand coordinator Yuan Keli submitted: "If Hui is indeed without the Way, the queen dowager should be allowed to submit a full memorial and await reestablishment by China.
translations.idiomatic: Dengzhou grand coordinator Yuan Keli submitted: "If Hui is indeed without the Way, the queen dowager should be allowed to submit a full memorial and await reestablishment by China.

sentences.zh: 」疏留中。

translations.literal: " The memorial was held at court.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was held at court.

sentences.zh: 八月，王妃金氏疏請封倧，禮部尚書林堯俞言：「朝鮮廢立之事，內外諸臣抒忠發憤，有謂宜聲罪致討者，有謂勿遽討且受方貢核顛末者，或謂當責以大義，察輿情之向背者，或謂當令亻宗討敵自洗者，眾論鹹有可采。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Queen Consort Lady Jin submitted a memorial requesting investiture for Jeong; Minister of Rites Lin Yaoyu said: "On the matter of Korea's deposition and enthronement, officials within and without have poured forth loyal indignation: some say we should proclaim guilt and launch punitive action; some say we should not hasten to punish but accept their tribute and verify the facts; some say we should charge them with the great principle and observe where popular sentiment inclines; some say Jeong should be ordered to campaign against the enemy to clear himself—all these views have points worth adopting.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Queen Consort Lady Jin submitted a memorial requesting investiture for Jeong; Minister of Rites Lin Yaoyu said: "On Korea's deposition and enthronement, officials within and without have poured forth loyal indignation: some say we should proclaim guilt and launch punitive action; some say we should not hasten to punish but accept their tribute and verify the facts; some say we should charge them with the great principle and observe where popular sentiment inclines; some say Jeong should be ordered to campaign against the enemy to clear himself—all these views have points worth adopting.

sentences.zh: 其謂琿實悖德，倧討叛臣以赤心奉朝廷者，惟文龍一人耳。

translations.literal: Of those who say Hui was truly devoid of virtue and that Jeong suppressed rebels with a loyal heart in service to the court, Wenlong alone is such a man.
translations.idiomatic: Of those who say Hui was truly devoid of virtue and that Jeong suppressed rebels with a loyal heart in service to the court, Wenlong alone is such a man.

sentences.zh: 皇上奉天討逆，扶植綱常，此正法也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, following Heaven, punishes rebellion and upholds the moral order—this is the correct law.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, following Heaven, punishes rebellion and upholds the moral order—this is the correct law.

sentences.zh: 毋亦念彼素稱恭順，迥異諸裔，則更遣貞士信臣，會同文龍，公集臣民，再四詢訪。

translations.literal: Yet also consider that they have long been called respectful and compliant, utterly unlike other border peoples—then dispatch upright and trustworthy officials, together with Wenlong, to assemble officials and people openly and inquire repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Yet also consider that they have long been called respectful and compliant, utterly unlike other border peoples—then dispatch upright and trustworthy officials, together with Wenlong, to assemble officials and people openly and inquire repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 勘辨既明，再請聖斷。

translations.literal: Once investigation and judgment are clear, then request the sacred decision again.
translations.idiomatic: Once investigation and judgment are clear, then request the sacred decision again.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 十二月，禮部復上言：「臣前同兵部移咨登撫，並劄毛師，遣官往勘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Ministry of Rites again submitted: "Your servant previously jointly with the Ministry of War sent instructions to the Dengzhou grand coordinator and also wrote to Commander Mao, dispatching officials to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Ministry of Rites again submitted: "Your servant previously jointly with the Ministry of War sent instructions to the Dengzhou grand coordinator and also wrote to Commander Mao, dispatching officials to investigate.

sentences.zh: 今據申送彼國公結十二道，自宗室至八道臣民共稱倧為恭順。

translations.literal: Now according to the twelve jointly signed documents submitted from that state, from the royal house to the officials and people of the eight provinces, all call Jeong respectful and compliant.
translations.idiomatic: Now according to the twelve jointly signed documents submitted from that state, from the royal house to the officials and people of the eight provinces, all call Jeong respectful and compliant.

sentences.zh: 且彼之陪臣相率哀籲，謂當此危急之秋，必須君國之主。

translations.literal: Moreover their envoys have one after another pleaded in grief, saying that in this hour of critical peril a ruler who can govern the state is essential.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover their envoys have one after another pleaded in grief, saying that in this hour of critical peril a ruler who can govern the state is essential.

sentences.zh: 乞先頒敕諭，令倧統理國事，仍令發兵索賦，同文龍設伏出奇，俟漸有次第，始遣重臣往正封典。

translations.literal: They beg that an edict of instruction be issued first, ordering Jeong to administer state affairs, and also ordering the dispatch of troops and collection of levies, together with Wenlong setting ambushes and striking with surprise; when matters gradually take order, then send a high official to confer the proper investiture.
translations.idiomatic: They beg that an edict of instruction be issued first, ordering Jeong to administer state affairs and also ordering the dispatch of troops and collection of levies, together with Wenlong setting ambushes and striking with surprise; when matters gradually take order, then send a high official to confer the proper investiture.

sentences.zh: 庶幾字小之中，不失固圉之道。

translations.literal: Thus perhaps within the care shown to a small state the way of securing the frontier will not be lost.
translations.idiomatic: Thus perhaps within the care shown to a small state the way of securing the frontier will not be lost.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，封倧為國王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year Jeong was invested as king.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year Jeong was invested as king.

sentences.zh: 五年十二月，文龍報：「朝鮮逆党李適、韓明璉等起兵昌城，直趨王京，被臣擒獲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fifth year Wenlong reported: "The Korean rebel faction Li Shi, Han Minglian, and others raised troops at Changseong and marched straight on the royal capital; they were captured by your servant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fifth year Wenlong reported: "The Korean rebel faction Li Shi, Han Minglian, and others raised troops at Changseong and marched straight on the royal capital; they were captured by your servant.

sentences.zh: 餘孽韓潤、鄭梅等竄入建州，有左議府尹義立約為內應，期今冬大舉犯朝鮮。

translations.literal: The remaining ringleaders Han Run, Zheng Mei, and others fled into Jianzhou; Left State Councilor Yin Yili arranged to serve as internal collaborators, planning a major invasion of Korea this winter.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining ringleaders Han Run, Zheng Mei, and others fled into Jianzhou; Left State Councilor Yin Yili arranged to serve as internal collaborators, planning a major invasion of Korea this winter.

sentences.zh: 臣已咨國王防守，暫移鐵山之眾就雲從島柴薪。

translations.literal: Your servant has already consulted the king on defense and temporarily moved the forces at Tieshan to gather firewood at Yundao Island.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has already consulted the king on defense and temporarily moved the forces at Tieshan to gather firewood at Yundao Island.

sentences.zh: 」登萊巡撫武之望奏：「毛帥自五月以來，營室於須彌，所謂雲從島是也。

translations.literal: " The Deng-Lai grand coordinator Wu Zhiwang memorialized: "Since the fifth month Commander Mao has built quarters at Sumi—what is called Yundao Island.
translations.idiomatic: The Deng-Lai grand coordinator Wu Zhiwang memorialized: "Since the fifth month Commander Mao has built quarters at Sumi—what is called Yundao Island.

sentences.zh: 今十月又徙兵民商賈以實之，而鐵山之地空矣。

translations.literal: Now in the tenth month he has again moved troops, civilians, and merchants to fill it, and the land at Tieshan is empty.
translations.idiomatic: Now in the tenth month he has again moved troops, civilians, and merchants to fill it, and the land at Tieshan is empty.

sentences.zh: 故朝鮮各道疑其有逼處之嫌，甚至布兵以防禦之。

translations.literal: Therefore the various Korean provinces suspect there is cause for concern over encroachment, and some have even deployed troops in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the various Korean provinces suspect there is cause for concern over encroachment, and some have even deployed troops in defense.

sentences.zh: 今鎮臣所稱李適等之叛，尹義立之內應，臣等微聞之，而未敢遽信焉。

translations.literal: What the regional commander reports of the rebellion of Li Shi and the internal collusion of Yin Yili, your servants have faintly heard of it but did not dare hastily to believe it.
translations.idiomatic: What the regional commander reports of the rebellion of Li Shi and the internal collusion of Yin Yili, your servants have faintly heard of it but did not dare hastily to believe it.

sentences.zh: 信之則益重鮮人之疑，不信則恐貽後來之患。

translations.literal: If we believe it, we will only deepen Korean suspicions; if we do not believe it, we may leave trouble for the future.
translations.idiomatic: If we believe it, we will only deepen Korean suspicions; if we do not believe it, we may leave trouble for the future.

sentences.zh: 」兵部言：「牽制敵國者，朝鮮也；

translations.literal: " The Ministry of War said: "The one who checks the enemy state is Korea;
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War said: "The one who checks the enemy state is Korea;

sentences.zh: 聯屬朝鮮者，毛鎮也；

translations.literal: the one who links Korea is the Mao garrison;
translations.idiomatic: the one who links Korea is the Mao garrison;

sentences.zh: 駕馭毛鎮者，登撫也。

translations.literal: the one who controls the Mao garrison is the Dengzhou grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: the one who controls the Mao garrison is the Dengzhou grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 今撫臣與鎮臣不和，以至鎮臣與屬國不和，大不利。

translations.literal: Now the grand coordinator and the regional commander are at odds, to the point that the regional commander is at odds with the tributary state—this is greatly unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: Now the grand coordinator and the regional commander are at odds, to the point that the regional commander is at odds with the tributary state—this is greatly unfavorable.

sentences.zh: 」帝乃飭勉鎮撫同心，而韓潤、尹義立等令朝鮮自處。

translations.literal: " The emperor then admonished the regional and grand coordinators to act in concert, and left Han Run, Yin Yili, and the others for Korea to handle itself.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then admonished the regional and grand coordinators to act in concert, and left Han Run, Yin Yili, and the others for Korea to handle itself.

sentences.zh: 倧又請撤遼民安插中土，兵部言：「遼人去留，文龍是視。

translations.literal: Jeong also requested the removal of Liaodong civilians settled in the interior; the Ministry of War said: "Whether Liaodong people stay or go depends on Wenlong.
translations.idiomatic: Jeong also requested the removal of Liaodong civilians settled in the interior; the Ministry of War said: "Whether Liaodong people stay or go depends on Wenlong.

sentences.zh: 文龍一日不去，則遼人一日不離。

translations.literal: As long as Wenlong does not leave, the Liaodong people will not depart.
translations.idiomatic: As long as Wenlong does not leave, the Liaodong people will not depart.

sentences.zh: 鮮人驅之入島可也，驅之離島不可也。

translations.literal: It is acceptable for Koreans to drive them onto the island; it is not acceptable to drive them off the island.
translations.idiomatic: It is acceptable for Koreans to drive them onto the island; it is not acceptable to drive them off the island.

sentences.zh: 宜令鎮臣將遼民盡刷過島，登撫刻期運糧朝鮮，量行救振，以資屯牧。

translations.literal: The regional commander should be ordered to move all Liaodong civilians onto the island; the Dengzhou grand coordinator should set a deadline to transport grain to Korea and provide relief as appropriate to support garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: The regional commander should be ordered to move all Liaodong civilians onto the island; the Dengzhou grand coordinator should set a deadline to transport grain to Korea and provide relief as appropriate to support garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 」帝是之。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 六年十月，倧上疏曰：

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year Jeong submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the sixth year Jeong submitted a memorial saying:

sentences.zh: 皇朝之於小邦，覆幬之恩，視同服內。

translations.literal: The august court's kindness toward our small state, sheltering us as if we were within the inner domain.
translations.idiomatic: The august court's kindness toward our small state shelters us as if we were within the inner domain.

sentences.zh: 頃遭昏亂，潛通敵國，皇天震怒，降黜厥命。

translations.literal: Recently we suffered disorder and secretly communicated with the enemy state; Heaven was angered and deposed our mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Recently we suffered disorder and secretly communicated with the enemy state; Heaven was angered and deposed our mandate.

sentences.zh: 臣自權署之初，不敢遑寧，即命陪臣張晚為帥，李適副之，付以國中精銳，進屯甯邊，一聽毛鎮節制，以候協剿之期。

translations.literal: From the beginning of my provisional administration I have not dared rest; I immediately appointed envoy Zhang Wan as commander and Li Shi as his deputy, giving them the elite forces of the state, advancing to encamp at Pyeongan, entirely under Commander Mao's direction, to await the time for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: From the beginning of my provisional administration I have not dared rest; I immediately appointed envoy Zhang Wan as commander and Li Shi as his deputy, giving them the elite forces of the state and advancing to encamp at Pyeongan, entirely under Commander Mao's direction, to await the time for joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 而適重兵在握，潛蓄覬覦，遂與龜城府使明璉舉兵內叛，直犯京城。

translations.literal: But Shi, with heavy troops in hand, secretly harbored ambition, and together with Gyeongju prefect Han Minglian raised troops in internal rebellion and marched straight on the capital.
translations.idiomatic: But Shi, with heavy troops in hand, secretly harbored ambition, and together with Gyeongju prefect Han Minglian raised troops in internal rebellion and marched straight on the capital.

sentences.zh: 晚收餘兵躡其後，與京輔官兵表裏夾攻，賊皆授首，而西邊軍實及列鎮儲偫罄於是役矣。

translations.literal: Wan gathered the remaining troops and followed behind, and with the capital garrison acting in concert from within and without, the rebels were all beheaded; yet the military strength of the western frontier and the stored provisions of the garrison districts were exhausted in this campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Wan gathered the remaining troops and followed behind, and with the capital garrison acting in concert from within and without, the rebels were all beheaded; yet the military strength of the western frontier and the stored provisions of the garrison districts were exhausted in this campaign.

sentences.zh: 毛鎮當全遼淪沒之後，孤軍東渡，寄寓海上，招集遼民前後數十萬，亦小邦所仰藉也。

translations.literal: Commander Mao, after all of Liaodong had fallen, crossed east alone with a solitary army, dwelling on the sea and gathering Liaodong civilians numbering several hundred thousand in all—our small state also relies on him.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Mao, after all of Liaodong had fallen, crossed east alone with a solitary army, dwelling on the sea and gathering Liaodong civilians numbering several hundred thousand in all—our small state also relies on him.

sentences.zh: 顧以封疆多故，土瘠民貧，內供本國之軍需，外濟鎮兵之待哺，生谷有限，支給實難。

translations.literal: Yet with the borders in constant turmoil, the soil poor and the people impoverished, supplying our own state's military needs within and sustaining the garrison troops' rations without—the living grain is limited, and support is truly difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Yet with the borders in constant turmoil, the soil poor and the people impoverished, supplying our own state's military needs within and sustaining the garrison troops' rations without—the living grain is limited, and support is truly difficult.

sentences.zh: 遼民迫於饑餒，散佈村落，強者攫奪，弱者丐乞。

translations.literal: Liaodong people, pressed by hunger, scattered through the villages; the strong seized by force, the weak begged for food.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong people, pressed by hunger, scattered through the villages; the strong seized by force, the weak begged for food.

sentences.zh: 小邦兵民被撓不堪，拋棄鄉邑，轉徙內地。

translations.literal: Our small state's soldiers and civilians, harassed beyond endurance, abandoned their villages and moved into the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Our small state's soldiers and civilians, harassed beyond endurance, abandoned their villages and moved into the interior.

sentences.zh: 遼民逐食，亦隨而入。

translations.literal: Liaodong people seeking food followed them in as well.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong people seeking food followed them in as well.

sentences.zh: 自昌、義以南，安、肅以北，客居六七，主居三四。

translations.literal: From Chang and Ui southward and An and Suk northward, guests occupy six or seven parts and hosts three or four.
translations.idiomatic: From Chang and Ui southward and An and Suk northward, guests occupy six or seven parts and hosts three or four.

sentences.zh: 向者將此情形具奏，見兵部題覆處分已定，何敢再幹。

translations.literal: Previously I reported this situation in full; once the Ministry of War had replied with its disposition settled, how could I dare raise it again.
translations.idiomatic: Previously I reported this situation in full; once the Ministry of War had replied with its disposition settled, how could I dare raise it again.

sentences.zh: 至韓潤及弟潭系逆賊明璉子侄，亡命潛逃，因而勾引來寇。

translations.literal: As for Han Run and his younger brother Tan, they are the sons and nephews of the rebel Minglian; they fled as outlaws and in flight drew the enemy to invade.
translations.idiomatic: As for Han Run and his younger brother Tan, they are the sons and nephews of the rebel Minglian; they fled as outlaws and in flight drew the enemy to invade.

sentences.zh: 賊既叛國而去，制命已不在臣。

translations.literal: Once the rebels had betrayed the state and fled, command over them was no longer in my hands.
translations.idiomatic: Once the rebels had betrayed the state and fled, command over them was no longer in my hands.

sentences.zh: 尹義立曾任判書，本非議政。

translations.literal: Yin Yili once served as minister of the board; he was never a chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Yili once served as minister of the board; he was never a chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 頃年差為毛鎮接伴官，不稱任使，褫職歸家，並無怨叛之事。

translations.literal: In recent years he was assigned as Commander Mao's reception officer; he did not fulfill his duties, was stripped of office and returned home, and there was no matter of resentment or rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years he was assigned as Commander Mao's reception officer; he did not fulfill his duties, was stripped of office and returned home, and there was no matter of resentment or rebellion.

sentences.zh: 毛鎮據王仲保等所訴，都無實事。

translations.literal: Commander Mao, relying on the complaints of Wang Zhongbao and others, found no substantiating facts at all.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Mao, relying on the complaints of Wang Zhongbao and others, found no substantiating facts at all.

sentences.zh: 意必有讒邪之臣，欺妄督撫，以售其交構之計者。

translations.literal: I suspect there are slanderous ministers who deceived the grand coordinator and sold their scheme of sowing discord.
translations.idiomatic: I suspect there are slanderous ministers who deceived the grand coordinator and sold their scheme of sowing discord.

sentences.zh: 毛帥久鎮海外，臣與周旋已近十稔。

translations.literal: Commander Mao has long garrisoned beyond the sea; I have dealt with him for nearly ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Mao has long garrisoned beyond the sea; I have dealt with him for nearly ten years.

sentences.zh: 雖餼牽將竭，彼此俱困，而情誼之殷，實無少損。
