translations.literal: Although provisions are nearly exhausted and both sides are equally distressed, the warmth of our bond has truly not diminished in the least.
translations.idiomatic: Although provisions are nearly exhausted and both sides are equally distressed, the warmth of our bond has truly not diminished in the least.

sentences.zh: 且其須彌之遷，直為保護累重，將以就便芻薪。

translations.literal: Moreover his move to Sumi was directly to protect his heavy encumbrance and to obtain fodder and firewood conveniently.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover his move to Sumi was directly to protect his heavy encumbrance and to obtain fodder and firewood conveniently.

sentences.zh: 一進一退，兵家常事。

translations.literal: Advancing and retreating are common matters in warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing and retreating are common matters in warfare.

sentences.zh: 訛言噂遝，本不介意。

translations.literal: Rumors and gossip I originally did not take to heart.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors and gossip I originally did not take to heart.

sentences.zh: 竊見部撫移咨曰「虞其逼處」，曰「驅其民，驅其帥」，甚至有「布兵以防，屬國攜貳」之語，似海外情事，未盡諒悉。

translations.literal: I have seen the ministry and grand coordinator's dispatch say "fear encroachment," say "drive out their people, drive out their commander," and even language of "deploying troops in defense, the tributary state turning disloyal"—it seems affairs beyond the sea have not been fully understood.
translations.idiomatic: I have seen the ministry and grand coordinator's dispatch say "fear encroachment," say "drive out their people, drive out their commander," and even language of "deploying troops in defense, the tributary state turning disloyal"—it seems affairs beyond the sea have not been fully understood.

sentences.zh: 臣之請刷遼民，因力不足濟，初非慮及逼處也。

translations.literal: My request to relocate Liaodong civilians arose because my strength was insufficient to sustain them; it was not originally from fear of encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: My request to relocate Liaodong civilians arose because my strength was insufficient to sustain them; it was not originally from fear of encroachment.

sentences.zh: 臣方與毛鎮同心一力，建功報主，豈敢有一毫猜防意乎。

translations.literal: I am now of one mind with Commander Mao, striving together to achieve merit and repay our lord—how could I dare harbor the slightest suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: I am now of one mind with Commander Mao, striving together to achieve merit and repay our lord—how could I dare harbor the slightest suspicion.

sentences.zh: 帝報曰：「王和協東鎮，愛戴中朝，忠貞之忱，溢乎言表。

translations.literal: The emperor replied: "The king harmonizes with the eastern garrison and cherishes the central court; loyal devotion overflows in your words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "The king harmonizes with the eastern garrison and cherishes the central court; loyal devotion overflows in your words.

sentences.zh: 鎮軍久懸，鮮、遼雜處。

translations.literal: The garrison army has long been suspended; Koreans and Liaodong people are mixed together.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison army has long been suspended; Koreans and Liaodong people are mixed together.

sentences.zh: 久客累主，生寡食多。

translations.literal: Long-staying guests burden their host; the living are few and the mouths to feed are many.
translations.idiomatic: Long-staying guests burden their host; the living are few and the mouths to feed are many.

sentences.zh: 微王言，朕有不坐照萬里之外者。

translations.literal: But for the king's words, there are matters ten thousand li away of which We would not have been fully informed.
translations.idiomatic: But for the king's words, there are matters ten thousand li away of which We would not have been fully informed.

sentences.zh: 然毛帥在中朝為牽制之師，在王國則脣齒之形也。

translations.literal: Yet Commander Mao, within China, is a force that checks the enemy; within the king's realm he is lip and teeth.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Commander Mao, within China, is a force that checks the enemy; within the king's realm he is lip and teeth.

sentences.zh: 海上芻輓，已令該部區畫，刻期運濟。

translations.literal: Transport of fodder by sea has already been ordered to the relevant ministry for planning, with a fixed deadline for delivery.
translations.idiomatic: Transport of fodder by sea has already been ordered to the relevant ministry for planning, with a fixed deadline for delivery.

sentences.zh: 逃難邊民，亦令毛帥悉心計處，俾無重為王累。

translations.literal: Refugee border people are also ordered to be fully arranged by Commander Mao so that they will not again heavily burden the king.
translations.idiomatic: Refugee border people are also ordered to be fully arranged by Commander Mao so that they will not again heavily burden the king.

sentences.zh: 傳訛之言，未足介懷，並力一心，王其勉之。」

translations.literal: Transmitted rumors are not worth taking to heart; exert your strength as one—let the king strive on."
translations.idiomatic: Transmitted rumors are not worth taking to heart; exert your strength as one—let the king strive on."

sentences.zh: 七年三月，兵部上文龍揭言：「麗官、麗人招敵攻鐵山，傷我兵千人，殺麗兵六萬，焚糧百余萬，敵遂移兵攻麗矣。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year the Ministry of War submitted Wenlong's memorial stating: "Korean officials and Korean people lured the enemy to attack Tieshan, wounding a thousand of our troops, killing sixty thousand Korean troops, and burning more than a million units of grain; the enemy then shifted troops to attack Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year the Ministry of War submitted Wenlong's memorial stating: "Korean officials and Korean people lured the enemy to attack Tieshan, wounding a thousand of our troops, killing sixty thousand Korean troops, and burning more than a million units of grain; the enemy then shifted troops to attack Korea.

sentences.zh: 」帝敕文龍速相機應援。

translations.literal: " The emperor commanded Wenlong to respond swiftly as circumstances allowed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commanded Wenlong to respond swiftly as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 登撫李嵩奏：「朝鮮叛臣韓潤等引敵入安州，節度使南以興自焚死，中國援兵都司王三桂等俱陣亡。

translations.literal: Grand coordinator Li Song memorialized: "The Korean rebel minister Han Run and others led the enemy into Anzhou; military governor Nam Yixing burned himself to death, and Chinese relief commanders including Metropolitan Commissioner Wang Sanguai all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Grand coordinator Li Song memorialized: "The Korean rebel minister Han Run and others led the enemy into Anzhou; military governor Nam Yixing burned himself to death, and Chinese relief commanders including Metropolitan Commissioner Wang Sanguai all died in battle.

sentences.zh: 」既復奏：「義州及郭山、淩漢、山城俱破，平壤、黃州不戰自潰，敵兵直抵中和，游騎出入黃、鳳之間，又分向雲從，攻掠毛帥，國王及士民遷于江華以避難。

translations.literal: " He memorialized again: "Uiju and Guoshan, Linghan, and the mountain fortress were all taken; Pyongyang and Hwangju collapsed without battle; enemy troops reached directly to Junghwa, raiding cavalry ranged between Hwang and Pung, and detachments also turned toward Yundao to attack and plunder Commander Mao; the king and officials and people moved to Ganghwa to escape the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again: "Uiju and Guoshan, Linghan, and the mountain fortress were all taken; Pyongyang and Hwangju collapsed without battle; enemy troops reached directly to Junghwa, raiding cavalry ranged between Hwang and Pung, and detachments also turned toward Yundao to attack and plunder Commander Mao; the king and officials and people moved to Ganghwa to escape the calamity.

sentences.zh: 」時大清兵所至輒下，朝鮮列城望風奔潰，乃遣使諭倧。

translations.literal: " At that time wherever the Great Qing troops arrived they took cities; Korean walled towns fled and collapsed at the wind; they then dispatched envoys to instruct Jeong.
translations.idiomatic: At that time wherever the Great Qing troops arrived they took cities; Korean walled towns fled and collapsed at the wind; they then dispatched envoys to instruct Jeong.

sentences.zh: 倧輸款，遂班師。

translations.literal: Jeong submitted terms of surrender, and they then withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Jeong submitted terms of surrender, and they then withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 九月，倧奏被兵情形。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Jeong memorialized on the circumstances of suffering attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Jeong memorialized on the circumstances of suffering attack.

sentences.zh: 時熹宗崩，莊烈帝嗣位，優詔勵勉焉。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Xizong died and Emperor Sizong succeeded; an edict of special favor encouraged and exhorted him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Xizong died and Emperor Sizong succeeded; an edict of special favor encouraged and exhorted him.

sentences.zh: 崇禎二年，改每歲兩貢為一貢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongzhen the annual two tribute missions were changed to one.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chongzhen the annual two tribute missions were changed to one.

sentences.zh: 先是，遼路阻絕，貢使取道登、萊，已十餘年矣。

translations.literal: Previously the Liaodong route had been cut off, and tribute envoys had taken the route through Deng and Lai for more than ten years already.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the Liaodong route had been cut off, and tribute envoys had taken the route through Deng and Lai for more than ten years already.

sentences.zh: 自袁崇煥督師，題改覺華，迂途冒險，其國屢請復故。

translations.literal: When Yuan Chonghuan served as supreme commander he proposed changing to Juehua, a roundabout route full of peril; their state repeatedly requested restoration of the former route.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Chonghuan served as supreme commander he proposed changing to Juehua, a roundabout route full of peril; their state repeatedly requested restoration of the former route.

sentences.zh: 至是遣戶曹判書鄭鬥源從登海來，移書登撫孫元化，屬其陳請。

translations.literal: At this time Minister of Revenue Zheng Douyuan came from the Deng-Hai route and sent a letter to grand coordinator Sun Yuanhua, asking him to submit the request on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Minister of Revenue Zheng Douyuan came from the Deng-Hai route and sent a letter to grand coordinator Sun Yuanhua, asking him to submit the request on their behalf.

sentences.zh: 元化委官伴送，仍疏聞。

translations.literal: Yuanhua delegated officials to escort them and also memorialized the court.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhua delegated officials to escort them and memorialized the court.

sentences.zh: 帝以水路既有成命，改途嫌於自便，不許。

translations.literal: The emperor held that since the water route already had an established order, changing routes seemed self-serving and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that since the water route already had a fixed arrangement, changing routes seemed self-serving and was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 是年六月，督師袁崇煥殺平遼將軍左都督毛文龍於雙島。

translations.literal: That year in the sixth month supreme commander Yuan Chonghuan executed Mao Wenlong, Pacification General of Liaodong and Left Censor-in-Chief, at Shuangdao.
translations.idiomatic: That year in the sixth month supreme commander Yuan Chonghuan executed Mao Wenlong, pacification general of Liaodong and left censor-in-chief, at Shuangdao.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，倧遺書總兵黃龍言：「文龍舊將孔有德、耿仲明率士卒二萬投順大清，向朝鮮征糧。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, sixth month, Jong sent a letter to regional commander Huang Long, stating: Mao Wenlong's former subordinates Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming led twenty thousand troops in submission to the Great Qing and came to Korea to requisition grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, sixth month, King Jong sent a letter to regional commander Huang Long, stating, "Mao Wenlong's former subordinates Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming have led twenty thousand troops in submission to the Great Qing and come to Korea to requisition grain.

sentences.zh: 本國以有德等曩在皮島為本國患，故未之應。

translations.literal: Our state, because Youde and the others had formerly been a calamity to our state while at Pidao, did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: Our state, because Youde and the others had formerly been a scourge to us while at Pidao, did not comply.

sentences.zh: 」龍以聞。

translations.literal: Huang Long reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Long reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，太宗文皇帝親征朝鮮，責其渝盟助明之罪，列城悉潰。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, first month, Taizong the Literary Emperor personally campaigned against Korea, charging it with breaking the alliance and aiding Ming; walled cities all collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, first month, Taizong the Literary Emperor personally campaigned against Korea, charging it with breaking the alliance and aiding Ming, and walled cities collapsed one after another.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮告急，命總兵陳洪范調各鎮舟師赴援。

translations.literal: Korea reported in urgent distress; regional commander Chen Hongfan was ordered to mobilize naval forces from various garrisons to aid them.
translations.idiomatic: Korea reported in urgent distress, and regional commander Chen Hongfan was ordered to mobilize naval forces from the various garrisons to go to their aid.

sentences.zh: 三月，洪范奏官兵出海。

translations.literal: In the third month Hongfan memorialized that government troops had put to sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Hongfan memorialized that government troops had put to sea.

sentences.zh: 越數日，山東巡撫顏繼祖奏屬國失守，江華已破，世子被擒，國王出降。

translations.literal: Several days later Shandong grand coordinator Yan Jizu memorialized that the tributary state had fallen, Ganghwa was already taken, the heir apparent was captured, and the king had surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later Shandong grand coordinator Yan Jizu memorialized that the tributary state had fallen, Ganghwa was already taken, the heir apparent had been captured, and the king had surrendered.

sentences.zh: 今大治舟艦，來攻皮島、鐵山，其鋒甚銳。

translations.literal: Now they are building warships in great numbers and coming to attack Pidao and Jeoksan—their momentum is very sharp.
translations.idiomatic: Now they are building warships in great numbers and coming to attack Pidao and Jeoksan, and their momentum is very sharp.

sentences.zh: 宜急敕沈世魁、陳洪範二鎮臣，以堅守皮島為第一義。

translations.literal: Shen Shikui and Chen Hongfan, the two garrison commanders, should be urgently ordered to make holding Pidao fast their first principle.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Shikui and Chen Hongfan, the two garrison commanders, should be urgently ordered to make holding Pidao their first priority.

sentences.zh: 帝以繼祖不能協圖匡救，切責之。

translations.literal: The emperor, holding that Jizu could not cooperate in planning rescue, sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, holding that Jizu had failed to cooperate in planning a rescue, sharply rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 亡何，皮島並為大清兵所破，朝鮮遂絕，不數載而明亦亡矣。

translations.literal: Before long Pidao was also broken by Great Qing troops; contact with Korea then ceased, and within a few years Ming also perished.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Pidao was also overrun by Great Qing troops; contact with Korea then ceased, and within a few years Ming perished as well.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮在明雖稱屬國，而無異域內。

translations.literal: Korea in Ming times, though called a tributary state, was no different from within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Korea in Ming times, though called a tributary state, was in practice no different from territory within the realm.

sentences.zh: 故朝貢絡繹，錫賚便蕃，殆不勝書，止著其有關治亂者於篇。

translations.literal: Therefore tribute missions came in unbroken succession and imperial gifts were frequent beyond full recording—this account records only those relevant to order and disorder in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute missions therefore came in unbroken succession and imperial gifts were too frequent to record in full; this chapter records only those matters bearing on order and disorder.

sentences.zh: 至國之風土物產，則具載前史，茲不復錄。

translations.literal: As for the state's customs and local products, the earlier histories record them fully and they are not repeated here.
translations.idiomatic: As for the state's customs and local products, the earlier histories record them fully, and they are not repeated here.
